title: Zero-Shot Coordination among LLM Agents
title_zh: LLM智能体之间的零样本协调

paragraphs.en: We study zero-shot coordination (ZSC), where independently developed agents must coordinate at test time. While ZSC has been well studied in the RL literature, far less is known about the performance of LLM agents despite their increasing deployment in such settings. Existing work on LLM coordination often relies on specialised scaffolding that independently developed agents are unlikely to share in practice. Moreover, evaluations on complex environments (e.g., Hanabi) make it difficult to pinpoint the sources of coordination failure. In contrast, we focus on simple, general-purpose scaffolds in minimal environments designed to isolate specific coordination challenges. Our results show that even in these controlled settings, frontier LLM agents struggle to coordinate, largely due to limited understanding of the coordination problem and weak reasoning about their partner’s beliefs. While LLMs introduce semantic information as an additional axis for coordination, they nonetheless fail to exploit this structure effectively. Towards this, we propose Coordination-friendly definitions (CFDs) as a principled approach for enabling robust coordination among LLM agents. Finally, we show that coordination-friendly definitions can be discovered automatically, removing the need for manual engineering. Code is available at https://github.com/ahayler/zsc-llm-agents .
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究零样本协调（ZSC），即独立开发的智能体必须在测试时进行协调。 虽然ZSC在强化学习文献中已被充分研究，但尽管大语言模型智能体在此类场景中的部署日益增多，人们对它们的协调表现却知之甚少。 现有的关于大语言模型协调的工作通常依赖专用的脚手架，而独立开发的智能体在实际中不太可能共享这些脚手架。 此外，在复杂环境（如Hanabi）上进行评估使得难以定位协调失败的具体原因。 与之相反，我们关注简单的、通用的脚手架，并在为隔离特定协调挑战而设计的最小化环境中进行研究。 我们的结果表明，即使在这些受控环境中，前沿大语言模型智能体也难以协调，这主要是由于对协调问题的理解有限，以及对伙伴信念的推理能力较弱。 虽然大语言模型引入了语义信息作为协调的额外维度，但它们仍未能有效利用这一结构。 为此，我们提出协调友好定义（CFDs），作为一种使大语言模型智能体之间实现稳健协调的原则性方法。 最后，我们证明协调友好定义可以被自动发现，从而无需人工工程化。 代码可在 https://github.com/ahayler/zsc-llm-agents 获取。

paragraphs.en: Rapid advances in AI have led to the deployment of autonomous agents in environments that require robust coordination with humans and other independently developed agents ( Dafoe et al., 2020 ; Kirkham et al., 2025 ; Müller and Žunič, 2024 ; Hu et al., 2020 ) . While humans often readily coordinate with unseen partners by reasoning about their behaviour, referred to as theory of mind (ToM) ( Premack and Woodruff, 1978 ) , autonomous agents struggle to do the same ( Lupu et al., 2026 ; Foerster, 2024 ) . A classic real-world example is that of autonomous driving, where vehicles developed independently by companies such as Waymo, Tesla, and Wayve must coordinate during on-road interactions ( Kirkham et al., 2025 ) .

paragraphs.en: With the rapid growth in large language models (LLMs) capabilities, LLM agents are increasingly deployed in real-world applications that require coordination with other independently developed agents. For example, in AI-assisted coding software such as Cursor, agents powered by different LLM providers are used together to collaboratively generate code ( Lin, 2026 ) . Similar settings also arise in robotics Ji et al. (2026) ; Liang et al. (2023) ; Szot et al. (2024) and autonomous driving Ishida et al. (2024) , where LLM agents generate policies as code that must coordinate with independently developed partners at deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）能力的快速增长，LLM 智能体越来越多地被部署到需要与其他独立开发的智能体协作的实际应用中。 例如，在 Cursor 等 AI 辅助编程软件中，由不同 LLM 提供商驱动的智能体被一起使用，以协作生成代码（ Lin, 2026 ）。 类似的场景也出现在机器人领域 Ji et al. (2026) ； Liang et al. (2023) ； Szot et al. (2024) 以及自动驾驶领域 Ishida et al. (2024) 中，其中 LLM 智能体以代码形式生成策略，这些策略在部署时必须与独立开发的伙伴智能体进行协调。

paragraphs.en: This problem is formally known as Zero-shot coordination (ZSC) ( Hu et al., 2020 ) , where agents are trained independently and evaluated together at test time without prior communication or re-training. Although ZSC prohibits agents from sharing policies, it permits prior agreement on a game-agnostic learning rule used during training. The central objective of ZSC is therefore to identify learning rules that encode general coordination principles applicable across a wide range of settings, while avoiding common failure modes. For example, the other-play Hu et al. (2020) learning rule ensures that the policy is equivariant with respect to the symmetries of the environment.
paragraphs.zh: 这个问题在形式上被称为零样本协调（Zero-shot coordination, ZSC）（Hu et al., 2020），其中各个智能体被独立训练，并在测试时无需事先通信或重新训练即可共同评估。 尽管零样本协调禁止智能体之间共享策略，但它允许事先就训练期间使用的、与具体博弈无关的学习规则达成一致。 因此，零样本协调的核心目标在于找出能够编码可广泛应用于各种场景的通用协调原则的学习规则，同时避免常见的失败模式。 例如，other-play 学习规则（Hu et al.） （2020）确保该策略对于环境的对称性保持等变性。

paragraphs.en: ZSC literature has predominantly focused on traditional deep reinforcement learning training pipelines ( Hu et al., 2020 ; Hu et al., 2021 ; Muglich et al., 2025 ) . More recently, however, the emergence of large language models has given rise to a new class of autonomous agents ( Müller and Žunič, 2024 ; Ning et al., 2025 ; Novikov et al., 2025 ) that differ substantially from this paradigm. Rather than requiring a large number of environment interactions Forkel et al. (2025) , LLM agents can coordinate zero-shot from a textual description of the environment via in-context learning (ICL), without any task-specific training. These textual descriptions expose an additional axis for coordination through the semantics of the environment, a signal that has proven difficult for traditional RL agents to exploit ( Ma et al., 2023 ) . As illustrated in Figure 5 , agents can use semantic cues (e.g., the “red arrow”) to coordinate their actions.
paragraphs.zh: ZSC 文献主要聚焦于传统的深度强化学习训练流程（Hu et al., 2020；Hu et al., 2021；Muglich et al., 2025）。 然而最近，大语言模型的出现催生了一类新型自主智能体（Müller and Žunič, 2024；Ning et al., 2025；Novikov et al., 2025），它们与这一范式存在本质区别。 这类智能体不需要大量的环境交互 Forkel et al. （2025），LLM 智能体可以通过上下文学习（ICL），仅凭环境的文本描述进行零样本协调，而无需任何针对特定任务的训练。 这些文本描述通过环境的语义提供了一个额外的协调维度，而这一信号已被证明是传统强化学习智能体难以利用的（Ma et al., 2023）。 如图 5 所示，智能体可以利用语义线索（例如“红色箭头”）来协调它们的动作。

paragraphs.en: We present the first systematic study of LLM agents in the ZSC setting, beginning with a formalisation of two of the most common scaffolds: text agents and code agents. We then introduce a suite of simplified cooperative environments, inspired by prior work ( Foerster et al., 2019 ; Hu et al., 2021 ; Lupu et al., 2021 ; Hu et al., 2022 ) , each designed to isolate a specific coordination challenge. We augment these environments with text descriptions to support interaction with LLM agents. Together, these environments cover a broad range of challenges an agent is likely to encounter in the real world. Consequently, we posit that strong performance on this suite is necessary but not sufficient for robust real-world coordination.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首次对零样本协调（ZSC）设定下的 LLM 智能体进行了系统性研究，首先对两种最常见的脚手架形式化：文本智能体与代码智能体。 随后，我们在先前工作的启发下（Foerster et al., 2019；Hu et al., 2021；Lupu et al., 2021；Hu et al., 2022）引入了一组简化的协作环境，每个环境都旨在隔离某一种特定的协调挑战。 我们为这些环境补充了文本描述，以支持与 LLM 智能体的交互。 这些环境共同涵盖了智能体在现实世界中可能遇到的广泛挑战。 因此，我们认为在该测试套件上取得出色表现是鲁棒的现实世界协调的必要条件，但并非充分条件。

paragraphs.en: We find that both classes of agents struggle to coordinate reliably in these simplified environments, driven in part by a weak understanding of the underlying coordination challenge and weak ToM abilities. Next, we find that agents have a strong bias toward leveraging environment semantics for coordination. This can yield improvements over traditional RL agents that struggle to exploit such cues; however, semantics also introduce coordination strategies that compete with existing ones, and agents that fail to consistently arbitrate between the two see degraded coordination. Overall, our results highlight the need for a new perspective on coordination with LLM agents.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发现，这两类智能体在这些简化环境中都难以可靠地进行协调，部分原因在于它们对潜在协调挑战的理解较弱，以及心智理论（ToM）能力较弱。 接下来，我们发现智能体在利用环境语义进行协调方面存在强烈的偏向。 相比难以利用此类线索的传统强化学习智能体，这可以带来改进；然而，语义也会引入与现有策略相竞争的协调策略，无法在两者之间稳定仲裁的智能体会出现协调性能下降。 总体而言，我们的结果凸显了以全新视角看待与 LLM 智能体协调的必要性。

paragraphs.en: Finally, inspired by the ZSC principle of a shared learning rule among coordinating entities, we introduce the notion of a Coordination-friendly definition (CFD) , a natural language specification of general coordination principles shared across agents. This mirrors analogous approaches in other domains, such as AI safety, where high-level rules are codified as a “constitution” to promote adherence to common safety standards ( Bai et al., 2022b ; Huang et al., 2024 ) . We show that incorporating a CFD improves coordination for both text and code agents across a range of environments, and that meta-learned principles within the CFD can outperform hand-crafted ones. Taken together, these results position CFD as a principled mechanism for enhancing coordination in LLM agents and a promising direction for future research.

sents.en: Finally, inspired by the ZSC principle of a shared learning rule among coordinating entities, we introduce the notion of a Coordination-friendly definition (CFD) , a natural language specification of general coordination principles shared across agents.

Agents share a common reward function R : 𝒮 × 𝒜 → Δ ⁡ ( ℝ ) R:\mathcal{S}\times\mathcal{A}\rightarrow\Delta(\mathbb{R}) . Each agent observes the environment via its observation function Z i : 𝒮 → Δ ⁡ ( 𝒪 i ) Z_{i}:\mathcal{S}\rightarrow\Delta\left(\mathcal{O}_{i}\right) . The action space can be written as a product 𝒜 = A 1 × ⋯ × A M \mathcal{A}=A_{1}\times\cdots\times A_{M} , where A i A_{i} corresponds to agent i i ’s action space. A (joint) policy π \pi is an M M -tuple of local policies π i : ℋ i → Δ ⁡ ( A i ) \pi_{i}:\mathcal{H}_{i}\rightarrow\Delta(A_{i}) , where ℋ i \mathcal{H}_{i} is the space of possible action-observation histories (AOHs) of player i i , each of the form τ t i = { o 0 i , a 0 i , … , a t − 1 i , o t i } \tau_{t}^{i}=\{o_{0}^{i},a_{0}^{i},\ldots,a_{t-1}^{i},o_{t}^{i}\} . The joint return is defined as J ⁡ ( π ) = 𝔼 π ​ [ ∑ t = 0 H γ t ​ R t ] J(\pi)=\mathbb{E}_{\pi}[\sum_{t=0}^{H}\gamma^{t}R_{t}] . We assume access to natural language descriptions 𝒟 = ( 𝒟 ℳ , 𝒟 ℛ , { 𝒟 ℋ i } i ∈ [ M ] ) \mathcal{D}=(\mathcal{D}_{\mathcal{M}},\mathcal{D}_{\mathcal{R}},\{\mathcal{D}_{\mathcal{H}_{i}}\}_{i\in[M]}) of the Dec-POMDP. paragraphs.en: We define an LLM agent as a system that leverages an LLM and in-context learning (ICL) to generate a local or joint policy π \pi for a Dec-POMDP. Crucially, ICL does not involve a separate training phase with gradient-based parameter updates; instead, all the “learning” occurs through conditioning on the prompt during the model’s forward pass. We consider two classes of LLM agents as illustrated in Figure 15 : text agents and code agents . Text agents are assigned to a role r ∈ ℛ r\in\mathcal{R} , take as input ( 𝒟 ℳ , 𝒟 ℛ ​ ( r ) , 𝒟 ℋ i ​ ( τ i ) ) (\mathcal{D}_{\mathcal{M}},\mathcal{D}_{\mathcal{R}}(r),\mathcal{D}_{\mathcal{H}_{i}}(\tau_{i})) and return an action a t i a_{t}^{i} , whereas code agents take as input 𝒟 ℳ \mathcal{D}_{\mathcal{M}} and return a joint policy π \pi as executable code. Since a joint policy specifies the behaviour of all players simultaneously, code agents require no role assignment via 𝒟 ℛ \mathcal{D}_{\mathcal{R}} ; the roles, together with their observations and actions, are already specified in 𝒟 ℳ \mathcal{D}_{\mathcal{M}} . A worked example of 𝒟 \mathcal{D} for Cat & Dog is given in Appendix D.2 . Hence, code agents induce a distribution over joint policies. In contrast, text agents do not produce an explicit joint policy; instead, they act on an implicit local policy π r \pi^{r} assigned to their role. As a result, their behaviour is harder to interpret or modify, and prompting an LLM for each action makes them slower and more expensive to evaluate.

paragraphs.en: The standard approach for training fully cooperative multi-agent RL systems is self-play (SP) ( Samuel, 1959 ; Tesauro, 1994 ) , wherein agents are trained alongside the same counterparts they will encounter at test time. In contrast, the ZSC setting ( Hu et al., 2020 ) assumes that independently trained policies are paired together at test time without prior communication or adaptation, a setting known as cross-play (XP). To enable coordination, entities are willing to coordinate on (part of) a Dec-POMDP-agnostic learning rule for training their agents. Examples of ZSC learning rules make use of known game symmetries ( Hu et al., 2020 ) or explicitly control for how agents reason about their partner ( Hu et al., 2021 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 训练完全合作的多智能体强化学习系统的标准方法是自博弈（SP）（Samuel, 1959；Tesauro, 1994），其中智能体与它们在测试时将遇到的相同对手一起训练。 相比之下，零样本协调（ZSC）设定（Hu et al., 2020）假设独立训练的策略在测试时被配对在一起，而无需事先沟通或适应，这一设定被称为交叉博弈（XP）。 为了实现协调，各参与方愿意在（部分的）与Dec-POMDP无关的学习规则上达成协调，用于训练它们的智能体。 ZSC学习规则的示例包括利用已知的博弈对称性（Hu et al., 2020），或显式控制智能体如何对其伙伴进行推理（Hu et al., 2021）。

sents.en: The standard approach for training fully cooperative multi-agent RL systems is self-play (SP) ( Samuel, 1959 ; Tesauro, 1994 ) , wherein agents are trained alongside the same counterparts they will encounter at test time.
sents.zh: 训练完全合作的多智能体强化学习系统的标准方法是自博弈（SP）（Samuel, 1959；Tesauro, 1994），其中智能体与它们在测试时将遇到的相同对手一起训练。

sents.en: In contrast, the ZSC setting ( Hu et al., 2020 ) assumes that independently trained policies are paired together at test time without prior communication or adaptation, a setting known as cross-play (XP).
sents.zh: 相比之下，零样本协调（ZSC）设定（Hu et al., 2020）假设独立训练的策略在测试时被配对在一起，而无需事先沟通或适应，这一设定被称为交叉博弈（XP）。

sents.en: To enable coordination, entities are willing to coordinate on (part of) a Dec-POMDP-agnostic learning rule for training their agents.
sents.zh: 为了实现协调，各参与方愿意在（部分的）与Dec-POMDP无关的学习规则上达成协调，用于训练它们的智能体。

sents.en: Examples of ZSC learning rules make use of known game symmetries ( Hu et al., 2020 ) or explicitly control for how agents reason about their partner ( Hu et al., 2021 ) .
sents.zh: ZSC学习规则的示例包括利用已知的博弈对称性（Hu et al., 2020），或显式控制智能体如何对其伙伴进行推理（Hu et al., 2021）。

paragraphs.en: We consider three evaluation variants. Self-play (SP) pairs a text agent with itself; for code agents, it is the score of the generated joint policy. The fixed LLM setting ( XP seed \text{XP}_{\text{seed}} ) applies only to code agents, which induce a distribution over joint policies: two policies are sampled independently from the same agent and evaluated under XP, measuring compatibility within a single distribution. The variable LLM setting ( XP LLM \text{XP}_{\text{LLM}} ), applicable to both code and text agents, instead pairs two distinct LLM agents under XP. A schematic of the evaluation regimes is provided in Figure 16 in the Appendix.
paragraphs.zh: 我们考虑三种评估变体。 自博弈（SP）将一个文本智能体与其自身配对；对于代码智能体，它是指生成的联合策略的得分。 固定LLM设置（XP seed \text{XP}_{\text{seed}}）仅适用于代码智能体，这类智能体会诱导出一个联合策略分布：从同一个智能体独立采样两个策略，并在XP下进行评估，以衡量单一分布内部的兼容性。 可变LLM设置（XP LLM \text{XP}_{\text{LLM}}）同时适用于代码智能体和文本智能体，它在XP下将两个不同的LLM智能体配对。 评估机制的示意图见附录中的图16。

paragraphs.en: We treat a single ICL generation as the analogue of a training run in tabula-rasa RL. For code agents, one generated joint policy therefore corresponds to one self-play training run, and pairing independently generated joint policies mirrors standard XP evaluation ( Hu et al., 2020 ) . For text agents, which only induce local policies, the distinction is less clear-cut. We refer to pairing two instances of the same LLM with the same prompt (but different roles) as SP, reflecting that providers may optimise models to work well with instances of themselves, e.g., as subagents within a shared harness. As we show in Figure 3 , even such local policies are not guaranteed to be mutually compatible.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将单次 ICL 生成视为白板 RL 中一次训练运行的类比。 因此，对代码智能体而言，一个生成的联合策略对应于一次自博弈训练运行，而将独立生成的联合策略配对则对应于标准的 XP 评估 ( Hu et al., 2020 ) 。 对于仅诱导出局部策略的文本智能体而言，这一区分就不那么明确了。 我们将使用相同提示词（但不同角色）配对同一 LLM 的两个实例称为 SP，这反映了模型提供商可能会优化模型使其与自身的其他实例良好协作，例如作为共享框架内的子智能体。 正如我们在图 3 中所示，即使是这样的局部策略也不能保证彼此兼容。

paragraphs.en: It is natural to ask whether LLM agents coordinate effectively out of the box, rendering further study unnecessary. Towards this, we conduct experiments across nine diverse coordination problems. Many of these are adapted from the ZSC literature, including Cat & Dog ( Hu et al., 2021 ) , Tiny Hanabi ( Foerster et al., 2019 ) and a variant of the lever game ( Hu et al., 2021 ; Treutlein et al., 2021 ) . Our choice of environments is motivated by two reasons: (a) each environment isolates a core coordination capability under ZSC evaluation in simplified settings, enabling a clean assessment of whether LLM agents exhibit the targeted behaviour; and (b) collectively, they span a diverse set of challenges that arise in real-world coordination. These include, for example, selecting a safe fallback in the absence of shared conventions, forming conventions at test time, and achieving coordinated symmetry breaking. A detailed description of the environments and the challenges they capture is provided in Appendix D . We emphasise that strong performance across these environments constitutes a necessary but not sufficient condition for effective real-world coordination. For instance, the narrow tunnel environment isolates the problem of tie-breaking, an issue that has been observed in deployed autonomous driving systems such as Waymo Foerster (2024) . If LLM agents are used to generate navigation policies for autonomous vehicles Ishida et al. (2024) , failures in this environment would likely translate to analogous failures in the real world.
paragraphs.zh: 一个自然的问题是：大语言模型智能体是否能够开箱即用地有效进行协调，从而使进一步的研究变得多余。 为此，我们在九个多样化的协调问题上进行了实验。 其中许多改编自零样本协调（ZSC）文献，包括 Cat & Dog（Hu et al., 2021）、Tiny Hanabi（Foerster et al., 2019）以及杠杆博弈的一个变体（Hu et al., 2021; Treutlein et al., 2021）。 我们选择这些环境的动机有两点：(a) 每个环境都在简化的设置下隔离出零样本协调评估中的一项核心协调能力，从而能够清晰地评估大语言模型智能体是否表现出目标行为；(b) 总体而言，它们涵盖了现实世界协调中出现的多样化挑战。 例如，这些挑战包括在缺乏共同约定时选择安全的回退方案、在测试时形成约定，以及实现协调的对称性破缺。 关于这些环境及其所涵盖挑战的详细描述见附录 D。 我们强调，在这些环境中的出色表现是有效现实世界协调的必要但非充分条件。 例如，狭窄隧道环境隔离了平局裁决问题，这一问题已在 Waymo 等已部署的自动驾驶系统中被观察到（Foerster (2024)）。 如果大语言模型智能体被用于为自动驾驶车辆生成导航策略（Ishida et al. (2024)），那么在该环境中的失败很可能转化为现实世界中类似的失败。

paragraphs.en: To ensure a fair evaluation, we include an explanation of the XP evaluation framework used, as well as provide explicit instructions to the agents to optimise their policies for high XP scores. The prompt templates used for both types of agents are reported in Appendix G.3 . While we evaluate agents across all environments, we conduct a detailed analysis on the Cat and Dog toy environment ( Hu et al., 2021 ) and a simplified variant of Hanabi Bard et al. (2020) , a widely used coordination benchmark. As we show later, coordination failure modes observed in Cat and Dog persist in the more complex game of Hanabi as well. In Cat & Dog, as shown in Figure 1 , there exist two incompatible conventions (light on ⇒ \Rightarrow cat and light on ⇒ \Rightarrow dog), both of which achieve the maximum reward of 10. However, without any prior communication, the (ZSC-optimal) strategy is to remove the wall, yielding a reward of 5. For code agents, we employ SOTA reasoning models, namely Grok 4.1 Fast, GPT-5.2, Gemini 3 Pro, Claude Opus 4.5 and DeepSeek V3.2. Due to cost reasons, we evaluate text agents in the SP setting across all games using GPT-5.2 and Grok 4.1 Fast, and restrict the variable LLM setting to Cat & Dog.
paragraphs.zh: 为确保评估的公平性，我们提供对所用 XP 评估框架的说明，并向智能体提供明确指令，要求其针对高 XP 分数优化自身策略。 两类智能体所使用的提示词模板见附录 G.3。 虽然我们在所有环境中评估智能体，但我们在 Cat and Dog 玩具环境（Hu et al., 2021）以及 Hanabi（Bard et al.）的简化变体上进行了详细分析。 (2020)，这是一个广泛使用的协作基准。 正如后文所示，在 Cat and Dog 中观察到的协作失败模式在更复杂的 Hanabi 游戏中同样存在。 在 Cat & Dog 中，如图 1 所示，存在两种不兼容的约定（灯亮 ⇒ \Rightarrow 猫 和 灯亮 ⇒ \Rightarrow 狗），二者均可获得 10 的最高奖励。 然而，在没有任何先验沟通的情况下，（ZSC 最优的）策略是移除隔墙，只能获得 5 的奖励。 对于代码智能体，我们采用 SOTA 推理模型，即 Grok 4.1 Fast、GPT-5.2、Gemini 3 Pro、Claude Opus 4.5 和 DeepSeek V3.2。 出于成本原因，我们在 SP 设置下使用 GPT-5.2 和 Grok 4.1 Fast 评估文本智能体在所有游戏中的表现，并将可变 LLM 设置限定在 Cat & Dog 上。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 1 , text agents coordinate poorly in Cat and Dog, resulting in XP scores well below the safe guaranteed reward of 5 5 obtained by removing the wall. We find that Gemini 3 Pro consistently adopts the convention light on ⇒ \Rightarrow cat , enabling it to coordinate with itself. Since this convention is arbitrary, it leads to poor coordination with other agents. An example failure case is shown in Figure 2 , which records the reasoning traces from an episode between Gemini 3 Pro and GPT 5.2. When acting as Alice, the Gemini agent recognises that any coordination convention is arbitrary , yet nevertheless selects one to avoid the − 5 -5 penalty and subsequently rationalises this choice as “natural”. In contrast, when acting as Bob, the GPT agent independently rationalises the opposite convention to be “natural”; importantly, it does not consider bailing as an option.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 1 所示，文本智能体在 Cat and Dog 中协调不佳，导致 XP 分数远低于拆除墙壁后可获得的 5 5 的安全保底奖励。 我们发现 Gemini 3 Pro 始终采用「灯亮 ⇒ 猫」这一约定，从而能够与自身协调。 由于该约定是任意的，它导致与其他智能体的协调不佳。 图 2 展示了一个失败案例，记录了 Gemini 3 Pro 与 GPT 5.2 之间一个回合的推理轨迹。 当扮演 Alice 时，Gemini 智能体认识到任何协调约定都是任意的，但仍选择了一个约定以避免 −5 惩罚，随后将该选择合理化为「自然的」。 相比之下，当扮演 Bob 时，GPT 智能体独立地将相反的约定合理化为「自然的」；值得注意的是，它并未将 bailing 视为一个选项。

sents.zh: 由于该约定是任意的，它导致与其他智能体的协调不佳。

sents.en: An example failure case is shown in Figure 2 , which records the reasoning traces from an episode between Gemini 3 Pro and GPT 5.2.
sents.zh: 图 2 展示了一个失败案例，记录了 Gemini 3 Pro 与 GPT 5.2 之间一个回合的推理轨迹。

sents.en: When acting as Alice, the Gemini agent recognises that any coordination convention is arbitrary , yet nevertheless selects one to avoid the − 5 -5 penalty and subsequently rationalises this choice as “natural”.
sents.zh: 当扮演 Alice 时，Gemini 智能体认识到任何协调约定都是任意的，但仍选择了一个约定以避免 −5 惩罚，随后将该选择合理化为「自然的」。

sents.en: In contrast, when acting as Bob, the GPT agent independently rationalises the opposite convention to be “natural”; importantly, it does not consider bailing as an option.
sents.zh: 相比之下，当扮演 Bob 时，GPT 智能体独立地将相反的约定合理化为「自然的」；值得注意的是，它并未将 bailing 视为一个选项。

paragraphs.en: Next, we estimate the empirical local policies of text agents by repeatedly prompting them 100 100 times from a fixed game state, as illustrated in Figure 3 . As Alice, we observe that Grok, Ministral, and Qwen3-Max consistently turn the light on regardless of the observed animal, yielding a degenerate signalling policy. GPT models exhibit similar behaviour, though with lower probability, opting to reveal in the remaining cases. We observe similarly degenerate behaviour as Bob. Ministral tends to bail when the light is off but guesses “dog” with high probability when the light is on, whereas Qwen3-Max guesses “cat” when the light is on and “dog” otherwise. Overall, their behaviour is largely arbitrary and degenerate. Surprisingly, smaller models such as Qwen3-14B and OLMo-32B-Think recover the optimal ZSC policy: revealing as Alice and bailing when observing a signal as Bob, despite being weaker than frontier models like Grok-4.1-Fast, GPT-5.2, and Qwen3-Max-Thinking at mainstream tasks such as Math and Coding. Notably, Qwen3-Max-Thinking ( ∼ 1 \sim\!1 T parameters) performs significantly worse than its smaller counterpart, Qwen3-14B. We observe a similar pattern for smaller models such as Grok 4.1 Fast and GPT-5 mini (see Table 3 in the Appendix), where increased reasoning effort correlates with lower coordination performance due to more frequent hallucinations of a shared convention. However, the relationship is mixed: for frontier models such as Claude Opus 5 and Grok 4.5, higher reasoning effort increases the reveal rate, whereas the newer GPT-5.6 Sol reveals far less often than GPT-5.2 (Appendix F.6 ). Greater model capability or reasoning effort therefore does not reliably translate into stronger ZSC.

paragraphs.en: Next, we examine how semantics, specifically, textual descriptions of the environment, affect the agents’ local policies. To this end, we consider two reformulations of the Cat & Dog game. First, we rename the signalling actions from “light on/off” to “red/blue light.” Second, we translate the entire environment description 𝒟 \mathcal{D} into German. The latter reflects settings where coordinating agents may access the same environment (e.g., a website) in different languages. Note that the payoffs in each of these cases is unchanged. We find that semantics can significantly influence the agents’ local policies as shown in Figure 18 (Top-Right and Bottom-Left) in the Appendix. For instance, GPT models become more grounded, choosing to reveal with higher probability when we relabel the actions to red light and blue light. In contrast, Qwen3-14B and OLMo-3-32B exhibit a reduced tendency to reveal, with Qwen3-14B increasingly opting to bail as Alice-an effect that is further amplified under the German relabeling. Meanwhile, Grok, Ministral, and GPT-5-Mini continue to exhibit degenerate policies across these modified environments. These results indicate that the models are unable to robustly reason about the game and are arbitrarily influenced by semantics .

paragraphs.en: As discussed in Section 1 , successful coordination requires theory of mind (ToM) ( Premack and Woodruff, 1978 ) , since agents must reason about which conventions, if any, their partners are likely to adopt. In the absence of an established convention, a well-calibrated agent should maintain uncertainty over how its partner will interpret a signal ( Hu et al., 2021 ) ; selecting the ambiguous signal anyway reflects a failure of this reasoning. We note, however, that failures in Cat & Dog do not by themselves causally separate weak ToM from a failure to recognise that no shared convention exists, and we view both as contributing factors. We observed that the agents are strongly averse to incurring the penalty for revealing, which pushes them to adopt an arbitrary signalling convention (also seen in Figure 2 ). Moreover, agents rationalise their chosen convention as the unique "natural" convention, something that the Gemini agent exploits for successful coordination ( Figure 1 ). We test whether this is a general strategy that other agents can also exploit. For this, we add the following instruction to the prompt: "You are playing a cooperative game with an identical instance of yourself. The same language model is used for both players, but each instance is assigned a different role in the game." If the model has a consistent notion of what it considers a "natural" convention, it should be able to coordinate on that convention and thereby achieve the maximum reward. That said, as shown in Figure 18 (Bottom-Right) in the Appendix, agents are unable to exhibit such capabilities. Instead, coordination performance deteriorates. For example, GPT-5.2, which initially revealed in about 75 % 75\% of cases, now adopts a degenerate policy of always turning the light on, as Alice, revealing in only about 5 % 5\% of cases. Similarly, Qwen3-14B and OLMo-32B-Think reduce their reveal rates to around 50 % 50\% when observing a dog, down from over 95 % 95\% . As Bob, they also shift toward guessing the animal more frequently, rather than bailing as they did previously. These results suggest that agents behave as though a consistent internal notion of a “natural” convention exists; however, in practice, no such consistency is observed .
paragraphs.zh: 正如第 1 节所讨论的，成功的协调需要心智理论（ToM）（Premack and Woodruff, 1978），因为智能体必须推理其对手可能采用哪些约定（如果有的话）。 在没有既定约定的情况下，一个校准良好的智能体应对其对手如何解读信号保持不确定性（Hu et al., 2021）；即便如此仍选择模糊信号，则反映了这种推理的失败。 然而，我们注意到，Cat & Dog 中的失败本身并不能在因果上区分弱 ToM 与未能认识到不存在共享约定这两种情况，我们认为两者都是促成因素。 我们观察到，智能体强烈厌恶因亮牌（revealing）而遭受惩罚，这促使它们采用任意的信号约定（也可参见图 2）。 此外，智能体会将其所选约定合理化为唯一“自然”的约定，而 Gemini 智能体正是利用这一点实现了成功协调（图 1）。 我们检验这是否是一种其他智能体也能利用的普遍策略。 为此，我们在提示中加入如下指令：“你正在与一个与你完全相同的实例玩一个合作游戏。 两个玩家使用同一个语言模型，但每个实例在游戏中被分配不同的角色。”如果该模型对其认为的“自然”约定有一致的概念，它应当能够在该约定上实现协调，从而获得最大奖励。 话虽如此，如附录中的图 18（右下）所示，智能体无法展现出这种能力。 相反，协调表现出现恶化。 例如，GPT-5.2 最初在约 75 % 75\% 的情况下选择亮牌，如今作为 Alice 却采取了总是开灯的退化策略，仅在约 5 % 5\% 的情况下亮牌。 类似地，Qwen3-14B 和 OLMo-32B-Think 在观察到狗时，其亮牌率从超过 95 % 95\% 降至约 50 % 50\%。 作为 Bob 时，它们也更频繁地转向猜测动物，而不是像之前那样选择弃权（bailing）。 这些结果表明，智能体的行为表现得好像存在一种一致的关于“自然”约定的内在概念；然而在实践中，并未观察到这种一致性。

paragraphs.en: Finally, we find that coordination failures in text agents are not limited to the Cat & Dog environment. As summarised in ( Table 1 in the Appendix), Grok 4.1 Fast and GPT 5.2 exhibit high failure rates in 7 / 9 7/9 tasks. Since these simplified environments are designed to isolate coordination failure modes, we examine whether the same failure modes persist in more complex settings. This helps validate our claim that strong performance in simplified environments is necessary but not sufficient for real-world coordination. We evaluate text agents on a 3x3 variant of Hanabi Bard et al. (2020) , of which Cat & Dog serves as an abstraction. The game mechanics are described in Appendix D in the Appendix, and results are shown in Figure 20 in the Appendix. We find that most failures stem from mismatched assumptions of shared conventions, closely mirroring our findings in Cat & Dog. For instance, a predominant failure mode arises when the clue receiver assumes the “Good Touch Principle” (i.e., that all hinted cards will be played), while the clue giver does not ( Figure 32 in the Appendix).

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the SP and XP performance of code agents both in the fixed LLM ( SP , XP seed \text{SP},\text{XP}_{\text{seed}} ) and variable LLM setting ( XP LLM \text{XP}_{\text{LLM}} ) and report the aggregated results in Figure 4 , providing detailed results in Appendix F.3 . Similar to text agents, code agents although aware of the safe reveal strategy are averse to the penalty associated with revealing. Adding to this we observe a strong bias toward adopting conventions based on semantics , primarily via lexicographical ordering . Yet, the agents frequently fail to agree on the ordering itself. For instance, assumptions such as cat < < dog and on < < off make mappings like cat → \rightarrow light on a common choice. However, many agents instead interpret light off/on as a binary signal, equating it with 0 / 1 0/1 , which yields light off = = cat resulting in coordination failure. More broadly, lexicographical ordering is a brittle ZSC coordination rule. For example, if agents use textual descriptions from different languages (as discussed in Figure 3 ), the ordering may invert. For example, Hund (dog) precedes Katze (cat) in German.

paragraphs.en: Similar coordination failures are observed across the remaining environments. This stems from code agents generating joint policies that achieve high self-play returns but coordinate poorly with other independently generated policies. Across both fixed and variable LLM settings, we observe a significant gap relative to SP returns (see Figure 4 ). Qualitative analysis (Appendix H ) further indicates that these policies are brittle and sheds light on the dominant failure modes across environments. Although the evaluation settings of code and text agents are not directly comparable, we qualitatively find that code agents are markedly more likely to resort to such brittle policies, while text agents exhibit more robust reasoning. Overall, our experiments demonstrate that both sets of agents perform poorly across the evaluated environments . This finding is particularly important in light of recent work deploying both text and code agents in real-world ZSC settings Liang et al. (2023) ; Szot et al. (2024) ; Ishida et al. (2024) .
paragraphs.zh: 在其余环境中也观察到类似的协调失败。 这源于代码智能体生成的联合策略虽然能在自博弈中获得高回报，但与其他独立生成的策略协调不佳。 在固定和可变 LLM 设置下，我们都观察到与自博弈回报相比存在显著差距（见图 4）。 定性分析（附录 H）进一步表明这些策略是脆弱的，并揭示了各环境中主要的失败模式。 尽管代码智能体和文本智能体的评估设置不能直接比较，我们定性地发现代码智能体明显更倾向于采用此类脆弱策略，而文本智能体则表现出更稳健的推理。 总体而言，我们的实验表明，两类智能体在所评估的环境中表现都很差。 鉴于最近有工作在现实世界的零样本协调（ZSC）场景中部署文本和代码智能体（Liang et al. paragraphs.en: LLM agents rely on textual descriptions of the Dec-POMDP to access the environment, thereby introducing semantics as an additional axis for coordination. Semantics have important implications for coordination, enabling agents to leverage semantic relationships between observations and actions that have been difficult for traditional RL methods to exploit ( Ma et al., 2023 ) . Moreover, semantics introduce new coordination strategies that compete with those grounded in the structure of the Dec-POMDP. As discussed in the previous section, LLM agents exhibit a strong bias toward leveraging semantic features for coordination; here, we investigate this more systematically, using environments specifically designed to isolate the role of semantics in coordination.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 智能体依赖 Dec-POMDP 的文本描述来访问环境，从而将语义引入为协调的一个额外维度。 语义对协调具有重要影响，使智能体能够利用观测与动作之间的语义关系，而这些关系是传统强化学习方法难以利用的（Ma et al., 2023）。 此外，语义引入了新的协调策略，这些策略与基于 Dec-POMDP 结构的协调策略相互竞争。 如上一节所讨论的，LLM 智能体在利用语义特征进行协调方面表现出强烈的倾向；在这里，我们对此进行更系统的研究，使用专门设计的环境来分离语义在协调中的作用。

sents.en: LLM agents rely on textual descriptions of the Dec-POMDP to access the environment, thereby introducing semantics as an additional axis for coordination.

paragraphs.en: Code agents achieve near-perfect XP returns on Tiny Hanabi Fixed, despite its close similarity to the Cat & Dog setting, which features a safe fallback and two symmetric but incompatible Nash equilibria. Inspection of the reasoning traces reveals that agents independently converge on a unique convention induced by the lexicographic mapping ( A ↦ 1 , C ↦ 2 ) (A\mapsto 1,C\mapsto 2) (see Figure 34 in the Appendix). Traditional ZSC algorithms, which cannot exploit such semantic structure, instead default to the safe fallback and incur lower rewards Foerster et al. (2019) ; Hu et al. (2021) .
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 Tiny Hanabi Fixed 与 Cat & Dog 设定高度相似——后者具有一个安全回退策略和两个对称但互不兼容的纳什均衡——代码智能体在其中仍能取得接近完美的 XP 回报。 对推理轨迹的检查表明，智能体独立收敛于由词典序映射 ( A ↦ 1 , C ↦ 2 ) (A\mapsto 1,C\mapsto 2) 所诱导的唯一约定（见附录中的图 34）。 传统 ZSC 算法无法利用这种语义结构，只能退而采用安全回退策略并获得较低的回报 Foerster et al. (2019) ; Hu et al. (2021) 。

sents.en: Code agents achieve near-perfect XP returns on Tiny Hanabi Fixed, despite its close similarity to the Cat & Dog setting, which features a safe fallback and two symmetric but incompatible Nash equilibria.

paragraphs.en: To further probe this ability, we evaluate text and code agents on the Hint–Guess game ( Ma et al., 2023 ) (Appendix D ), a task where success requires exploiting semantic relationships between observations and actions and where agents can coordinate through human-like reasoning patterns such as mutual exclusivity ( Markman and Wachtel, 1988 ) and implicature ( Grice, 1975 ) ( Figure 14 in the Appendix). Text agents perform strongly in this environment ( Figure 20 in the Appendix), matching the human baselines reported in ( Ma et al., 2023 ) and adopting the same coordination strategies as human players ( Table 8 in the Appendix); however, they occasionally suffer coordination failures that are unlikely to arise in human play ( Figure 41 in the Appendix). Code agents, in contrast, perform poorly ( Figure 20 in the Appendix): rather than grounding coordination in semantic features, they fall back on arbitrary conventions such as lexicographic sorting or positional indexing ( Figure 43 in the Appendix), and none of the resulting policies successfully leverage mutual exclusivity or implicature. This is consistent with our findings in Figure 3 , where code agents perform worse than text agents across the range of coordination tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 为了进一步探究这种能力，我们在提示-猜测（Hint–Guess）博弈（Ma et al., 2023）（附录D）上评估文本与代码智能体；在该任务中，成功需要利用观察与动作之间的语义关系，并且智能体可以通过互斥性（Markman and Wachtel, 1988）和会话含义（Grice, 1975）等人类式推理模式进行协调（附录中的图14）。 文本智能体在该环境中表现很强（附录中的图20），达到了（Ma et al., 2023）中报告的人类基线水平，并采用了与人类玩家相同的协调策略（附录中的表8）；然而，它们偶尔会出现协调失败，而这种情况在人类对局中不太可能发生（附录中的图41）。 相比之下，代码智能体表现不佳（附录中的图20）：它们没有将协调建立在语义特征之上，而是退而依赖词典序排序或位置索引等任意约定（附录中的图43），并且没有任何由此产生的策略能够成功利用互斥性或会话含义。 这与我们在图3中的发现一致，即在各类协调任务中，代码智能体的表现都逊于文本智能体。

paragraphs.en: Conversely, code agents achieve lower XP scores in the Tiny Hanabi environment, despite the presence of a unique optimal strategy ( A ↦ 2 , C ↦ 1 ) (A\mapsto 2,C\mapsto 1) . Analysis of the reasoning traces reveals that semantics introduce an additional coordination strategy based on lexicographic ordering, as discussed above, albeit with a lower joint return. The resulting competition between these strategies degrades XP performance, whereas traditional ZSC algorithms, which do not exploit such semantic structure, are not affected Foerster et al. (2019) .

sents.zh: 这些策略之间的竞争降低了 XP 性能，而传统的、不利用此类语义结构的零样本协调（ZSC）算法则不受影响 Foerster et al. (2019)。

paragraphs.en: To further investigate this competition, we introduce the Semantic Selection Game ( Figure 5 ) and the Semantic Convention Game (Appendix D ). Broadly, agents must choose between two competing and incompatible coordination strategies: coordinating on the uniquely SP-optimal joint policy, or coordinating based on the semantic relationship between the observations and actions. For example, as shown in Figure 5 , agents can either coordinate by selecting the lever with reward 1.01 or by choosing the lever marked with a “big red arrow”. Figure 5 demonstrates that the LLM agents fail to resolve this competition consistently, resulting in low XP scores. We find that Gemini 3 Pro is the only model that reliably selects the SP-optimal policy across all games. In contrast, the other LLM agents alternate between the two competing strategies. We find that Claude Opus 4.5 is particularly biased toward semantic alignment, selecting the semantic-aligned joint policy in all six runs of the semantic selection and in three out of six runs of the semantic convention game.
paragraphs.zh: 为了进一步研究这种竞争关系，我们引入了语义选择博弈（图 5）和语义约定博弈（附录 D）。 大体上，智能体必须在两种相互竞争且互不兼容的协调策略之间做出选择：要么在唯一 SP 最优的联合策略上进行协调，要么基于观测与动作之间的语义关系进行协调。 例如，如图 5 所示，智能体既可以通过选择奖励为 1.01 的拉杆来协调，也可以通过选择标有「大红箭头」的拉杆来协调。 图 5 表明，LLM 智能体无法始终一致地化解这种竞争，导致 XP 得分偏低。 我们发现，Gemini 3 Pro 是唯一能在所有博弈中稳定选择 SP 最优策略的模型。 相比之下，其他 LLM 智能体则在两种相互竞争的策略之间交替切换。 我们发现，Claude Opus 4.5 尤其偏向语义对齐，在语义选择博弈的全部六次运行中都选择了语义对齐的联合策略，在语义约定博弈的六次运行中有三次也是如此。

paragraphs.en: Direct reasoning about the environment allows LLM agents to identify optimal strategies that are difficult for traditional RL methods to discover through Monte Carlo rollouts, which are often prone to local minima. As shown in Appendix F.4 , LLM agents reliably discover self-explaining deviations in the trampoline–tiger coordination challenge ( Hu et al., 2022 ) , while widely used MARL algorithms such as MAPPO ( Yu et al., 2022 ) and QMIX ( Rashid et al., 2018 ) fail to uncover these solutions.
paragraphs.zh: 对环境进行直接推理使 LLM 智能体能够识别出传统强化学习方法难以通过蒙特卡洛模拟发现的最优策略，而蒙特卡洛模拟往往容易陷入局部最优。 如附录 F.4 所示，在蹦床—老虎协作挑战（Hu et al., 2022）中，LLM 智能体能够可靠地发现自我解释式的偏离行为，而 MAPPO（Yu et al., 2022）和 QMIX（Rashid et al., 2018）等广泛使用的 MARL 算法则无法找到这些解法。

paragraphs.en: The results in Figure 3 and Section 5 show that LLM agents fail even in simple settings, highlighting the need to adapt LLM agents for zero-shot coordination. Towards this, we propose a simple approach inspired by the core principle underlying ZSC algorithms. Prior work ( Hu et al., 2020 ) motivates the idea of a ZSC learning rule as follows: “suppose that multiple independent AI designers will construct agents that have to interact in various but ex-ante unknown Dec-POMDPs without being able to coordinate beforehand, what learning rule should these designers agree on?” In the context of LLM agents, we introduce the analogous notion of a coordination-friendly definition (CFD). A CFD comprises a set of textual instructions that encode general coordination principles used to guide agent behaviour. We assume that independent developers can agree on a shared CFD to facilitate coordination among their agents. Given the diversity of scaffolds, including the text and code agents described in Section 2 , we emphasise that CFDs should remain simple to ensure compatibility across implementations.
paragraphs.zh: 图3和第5节的结果表明，即使简单的设置下，大语言模型智能体（LLM agents）也会失败，这凸显了为零样本协调（ZSC）适配 LLM 智能体的必要性。 为此，我们提出了一种受 ZSC 算法核心原理启发的简单方法。 已有工作（Hu et al., 2020）对 ZSC 学习规则的设想如下：“假设多个独立的 AI 设计者将构建一些智能体，这些智能体必须在各种事前未知的 Dec-POMDP 中进行交互，且无法事先协调，那么这些设计者应当就哪种学习规则达成一致？”在 LLM 智能体的背景下，我们引入了一个类似的概念，称为协调友好定义（coordination-friendly definition, CFD）。 CFD 由一组文本指令组成，这些指令编码了用于指导智能体行为的一般协调原则。 我们假设独立的开发者可以就一个共享的 CFD 达成一致，以促进其智能体之间的协调。 鉴于脚手架（scaffolds）的多样性，包括第2节所述的文本智能体和代码智能体，我们强调 CFD 应保持简单，以确保跨实现的兼容性。

paragraphs.en: The CFD must influence the behaviour of the LLM agent, for example, by shaping the induced local policies of text agents or the joint policy generation process of code agents. In this work, we focus on the most straightforward application: incorporating the CFD directly into the prompt. We also briefly explore a specialised scaffold for code agents that introduces a policy critic to modify or reject generated joint policies based on compliance with the CFD. More advanced approaches, such as reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) Stiennon et al. (2020) ; Bai et al. (2022a) based on CFD compliance (similar to Bai et al. (2022b) ), remain a promising direction for future work but are beyond the scope of this work.
paragraphs.zh: CFD 必须能够影响 LLM 智能体的行为，例如通过塑造文本智能体诱导出的局部策略，或代码智能体的联合策略生成过程。 在本工作中，我们聚焦于最直接的应用方式：将 CFD 直接纳入提示词中。 我们还简要探索了一种面向代码智能体的专用脚手架，它引入了一个策略评判器，可根据对 CFD 的遵循情况来修改或拒绝生成的联合策略。 更先进的方法，例如基于 CFD 遵循情况的人类反馈强化学习（RLHF） Stiennon et al. paragraphs.en: We experiment with a simple hand-crafted CFD as shown in Figure 6 , which is based on preventing arbitrary conventions and role assignments ( Hu et al., 2020 ; Treutlein et al., 2021 ) . As shown in Figure 1 and Table 1 , Table 6 and Table 7 , the CFD improves the performance of both agents in the Cat & Dog environment, where agents now consistently choose to remove the wall. We find that the CFD has a stronger effect on text agents and smaller models, reducing the coordination failure rate in 6 / 9 6/9 environments for Grok 4.1 Fast and 5 / 9 5/9 for GPT-5.2 ( Table 1 in the Appendix). That said, the CFD can be too restrictive in some cases. In the ad-hoc conventions environments, the CFD biases the agents toward the safe fallback, preventing them from forming conventions at test time.
paragraphs.zh: 我们尝试了一种如图 6 所示的简单手工设计的 CFD，其思路是禁止任意的约定与角色分配（Hu et al., 2020；Treutlein et al., 2021）。 如图 1、表 1、表 6 和表 7 所示，CFD 提升了两个智能体在 Cat & Dog 环境中的表现，此时智能体始终选择移除墙壁。 我们发现，CFD 对文本智能体和较小模型的影响更强，在 6 / 9 6/9 个环境中降低了 Grok 4.1 Fast 的协作失败率，在 5 / 9 5/9 个环境中降低了 GPT-5.2 的协作失败率（附录中的表 1）。 尽管如此，CFD 在某些情况下可能过于严苛。 在临时约定（ad-hoc conventions）环境中，CFD 会使智能体偏向安全的回退方案，从而阻止它们在测试时形成约定。

paragraphs.en: The effect of the CFD is less pronounced for code agents, where it fails to reduce the SP-XP gap beyond the Cat & Dog and the Semantic Selection Game environments. We attribute this to the generally weaker coordination abilities of code agents, as documented in Figure 3 and Section 5 . Further examination of execution traces revealed that, while code agents adjust their generated policies in response to the CFD, these policies rarely account for edge cases, leading to coordination failures. Taken together, these results show that conditioning LLM agents on general coordination principles via a CFD is a simple and effective method for improving coordination.
paragraphs.zh: CFD 的效果在代码智能体上不太明显，在 Cat & Dog 和 Semantic Selection Game 环境之外，它未能进一步缩小 SP-XP 差距。 我们将此归因于代码智能体总体上较弱的协调能力，如图 3 和第 5 节所示。 对执行轨迹的进一步检查表明，虽然代码智能体会根据 CFD 调整其生成的策略，但这些策略很少考虑边缘情况，从而导致协调失败。 综上所述，这些结果表明，通过 CFD 将 LLM 智能体以一般协调原则为条件，是改善协调的一种简单而有效的方法。

sents.en: Taken together, these results show that conditioning LLM agents on general coordination principles via a CFD is a simple and effective method for improving coordination.
sents.zh: 综上所述，这些结果表明，通过 CFD 将 LLM 智能体以一般协调原则为条件，是改善协调的一种简单而有效的方法。

paragraphs.en: The hand-crafted CFD is only an initial attempt and, as noted above, does not apply to all coordination challenges. Rather than refining it by hand, we explore whether coordination-friendly definitions can be discovered automatically via meta-learning (“learning to learn”) Vanschoren (2019) ; Hospedales et al. (2022) ; Beck et al. (2025) , which has been shown to outperform human design choices.
paragraphs.zh: 手工设计的 CFD 只是一个初步尝试，并且如上所述，并不适用于所有协调挑战。 与其通过手工进行改进，我们探索能否通过元学习（“学习如何学习”）Vanschoren (2019)；Hospedales et al. (2022)；Beck et al. 自动发现有利于协调的定义。 (2025)，该方法已被证明优于人类的设计选择。

sents.en: (2025) , which has been shown to outperform human design choices.

paragraphs.en: To this end, we implement a meta-learning loop to autonomously discover CFDs using LLM-driven evolution. Our method is loosely based on GEPA Agrawal et al. (2026) , which employs Pareto-based candidate selection to improve sample efficiency in the evolutionary process. We combine this with other optimizations which increase the diversity of proposals in the evolutionary process and reduce the cost of “meta-step”. We provide further implementation details in Appendix G.1 . We meta-train the CFD on Cat & Dog and Brittle Bridge using Grok-4.1-Fast as the code agent, XP seed \text{XP}_{\text{seed}} as the measure of fitness and GPT 5.4 as the meta-optimisation agent. We additionally modify the code agent scaffold by introducing a policy critic that refines generated joint policies based on compliance with the CFD, while leaving the code generation process itself unconditioned on the CFD to preserve diversity. Empirically, this leads to more diverse solutions and reduced variance in the XP seed \text{XP}_{\text{seed}} score of generated policies. Further implementation details regarding the policy critic are provided in Appendix G.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 为此，我们实现了一个元学习循环，利用 LLM 驱动的进化来自主发现 CFD。 我们的方法 loosely（松散地）基于 GEPA（Agrawal 等人）。 （2026），该方法采用基于帕累托的候选选择来提高进化过程中的样本效率。 我们将其与其他优化相结合，这些优化增加了进化过程中提案的多样性并降低了“元步骤”的成本。 我们在附录 G.1 中提供了进一步的实现细节。 我们在 Cat & Dog 和 Brittle Bridge 上对 CFD 进行元训练，使用 Grok-4.1-Fast 作为代码智能体，XP seed \text{XP}_{\text{seed}} 作为适应度度量，GPT 5.4 作为元优化智能体。 我们还通过引入策略评论器对代码智能体框架进行了修改，该评论器根据对 CFD 的遵守程度来细化生成的联合策略，同时使代码生成过程本身不依赖于 CFD，以保持多样性。 从实证上看，这带来了更多样化的解决方案，并降低了生成策略在 XP seed \text{XP}_{\text{seed}} 得分上的方差。 关于策略评论器的进一步实现细节见附录 G.2。

sents.en: To this end, we implement a meta-learning loop to autonomously discover CFDs using LLM-driven evolution.
sents.zh: 为此，我们实现了一个元学习循环，利用 LLM 驱动的进化来自主发现 CFD。

sents.en: Our method is loosely based on GEPA Agrawal et al.
sents.zh: 我们的方法 loosely（松散地）基于 GEPA（Agrawal 等人）。

sents.en: (2026) , which employs Pareto-based candidate selection to improve sample efficiency in the evolutionary process.
sents.zh: （2026），该方法采用基于帕累托的候选选择来提高进化过程中的样本效率。

sents.en: We combine this with other optimizations which increase the diversity of proposals in the evolutionary process and reduce the cost of “meta-step”.

sents.en: We meta-train the CFD on Cat & Dog and Brittle Bridge using Grok-4.1-Fast as the code agent, XP seed \text{XP}_{\text{seed}} as the measure of fitness and GPT 5.4 as the meta-optimisation agent.

sents.en: We additionally modify the code agent scaffold by introducing a policy critic that refines generated joint policies based on compliance with the CFD, while leaving the code generation process itself unconditioned on the CFD to preserve diversity.

sents.en: Empirically, this leads to more diverse solutions and reduced variance in the XP seed \text{XP}_{\text{seed}} score of generated policies.
sents.zh: 从实证上看，这带来了更多样化的解决方案，并降低了生成策略在 XP seed \text{XP}_{\text{seed}} 得分上的方差。

sents.en: Further implementation details regarding the policy critic are provided in Appendix G.2 .

We further observe modest XP LLM \text{XP}_{\text{LLM}} gains across other models (GPT 5.2, Claude 4.5, Gemini 3 Pro) and the generic code-agent scaffold ( Figure 23 ), even though meta-training optimised XP seed \text{XP}_{\text{seed}} in the critic-based scaffold; we do not, however, observe XP seed \text{XP}_{\text{seed}} gains across LLM types ( Figure 22 ). Overall, CFDs can be efficiently meta-learned with inexpensive scaffolds while generalising to more capable agents for which direct optimisation would be infeasible.

paragraphs.en: We study the ZSC performance of LLM agents across a range of coordination tasks under the commonly used text and code scaffolds, and find that they consistently fail to coordinate effectively, even in simplified environments. Although the two scaffolds are not directly comparable, we qualitatively observe that code agents are more prone to brittle, arbitrary conventions than text agents, an observation worth noting given their increasing deployment in real-world settings Liang et al. (2023) ; Ji et al. (2026) ; Ishida et al. (2024) . We identify several factors that contribute to these failures: a limited understanding of the coordination problem, a failure to recognise that no shared convention has been established, and weak Theory of mind (ToM) reasoning about how a partner will interpret one’s actions. Our experiments do not causally isolate these factors from one another; rather, they jointly characterise the observed failures. We additionally find that LLM agents are biased toward exploiting semantic representations of the environment, which can both aid and impede coordination. Next, we introduce Coordination-friendly definition (CFD) , a simple and general mechanism for improving coordination that can be readily integrated into existing agent scaffolds, and show that coordination-friendly definitions can be automatically discovered through meta-learning, reducing the need for manual design.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了LLM智能体在常用文本与代码脚手架下、跨一系列协调任务中的零样本协调（ZSC）表现，发现它们始终无法有效协调，即使在简化环境中也是如此。 尽管这两种脚手架不能直接比较，我们定性观察到，相比文本智能体，代码智能体更容易形成脆弱且任意的约定；鉴于它们在现实场景中的部署日益增多，这一观察值得注意 Liang et al. (2023) ; Ji et al. (2026) ; Ishida et al. (2024) 。 我们识别出导致这些失败的若干因素：对协调问题的理解有限、未能认识到尚未建立任何共享约定，以及对伙伴将如何解读自身行为的心智理论（ToM）推理能力较弱。 我们的实验并未对这些因素进行因果上的相互分离；更确切地说，它们共同刻画了所观察到的失败。 我们还发现，LLM智能体偏向于利用环境的语义表示，这既可能促进也可能阻碍协调。 接着，我们引入协调友好定义（CFD），这是一种简单且通用的改善协调的机制，可以便捷地集成到现有智能体脚手架中，并表明协调友好定义可以通过元学习自动发现，从而减少人工设计的需要。

sents.en: Next, we introduce Coordination-friendly definition (CFD) , a simple and general mechanism for improving coordination that can be readily integrated into existing agent scaffolds, and show that coordination-friendly definitions can be automatically discovered through meta-learning, reducing the need for manual design.
sents.zh: 接着，我们引入协调友好定义（CFD），这是一种简单且通用的改善协调的机制，可以便捷地集成到现有智能体脚手架中，并表明协调友好定义可以通过元学习自动发现，从而减少人工设计的需要。

paragraphs.en: Both the hand-crafted and meta-learned coordination-friendly definitions remain relatively simple and do not apply to every coordination challenge. For the meta-learned CFD, we attribute this in part to the limited number of meta-training environments, in line with prior meta-learning work showing that broader task distributions yield more robust generalisation Oh et al. (2020) ; Oh et al. (2025) ; Goldie et al. (2026) ; the hand-crafted CFD, being designed manually, would similarly benefit from refinement on a wider range of coordination settings. In particular, coordination-friendly definitions can lead agents to under-coordinate : in the ad-hoc conventions environments, agents repeatedly choose the safe fallback instead of forming a convention at test time. This failure mode is not unique to our approach. Off-belief learning Hu et al. (2021) , for instance, would behave similarly, since it reinterprets the interaction history as though the partner had followed a random policy and therefore discards any ad-hoc convention formed during the interaction. Avoiding under-coordination while retaining robustness remains an open problem in ZSC. Nevertheless, we view under-coordination as preferable to the prevailing failure mode of over-coordination , in which agents rely on brittle, arbitrary conventions that lead to catastrophic coordination failures. Finally, due to cost, our variable-LLM evaluation of text agents is less extensive than that of code agents and concentrates on Cat & Dog, Hint-Guess, and the 3 × \times 3 Hanabi variant.
paragraphs.zh: 无论是手工设计的还是元学习得到的协调友好型定义都相对简单，并不能适用于每一种协调挑战。 对于元学习得到的 CFD，我们将此部分归因于元训练环境数量有限，这与先前元学习工作的结论一致，即更广泛的任务分布能带来更稳健的泛化能力 Oh et al. (2020)；Oh et al. (2025)；Goldie et al. (2026)；而手工设计的 CFD 由于是人工设计的，同样可以通过在更广泛的协调场景上进行改进而受益。 特别是，协调友好型定义可能导致智能体协调不足：在临时约定环境中，智能体在测试时反复选择安全的后备选项，而不是形成约定。 这种失败模式并非我们方法所独有。 例如，离信念学习 Hu et al. paragraphs.en: Alternative integration mechanisms beyond prompting, such as RLHF-based CFD compliance Bai et al. (2022b) , are discussed in Section 6 . In addition, principles from traditional ZSC algorithms Hu et al. (2021) ; Hu et al. (2020) may be adapted in conjunction with LLM-RL methods such as GRPO Guo et al. (2025) to improve coordination in LLM agents. We find a mixed relationship between reasoning capacity and ZSC performance (Appendix F.6 ): more capable models or higher reasoning effort do not reliably yield better coordination, and understanding when they do is an important open question. Beyond our minimal environments, LLM agents should be evaluated in more complex settings such as Overcooked Gessler et al. (2025) , where agents can adapt to their partner within an episode. Two related settings fall outside the standard ZSC framework but capture important real-world challenges: adaptation to a partner across repeated episodes, and coordination given a small number of demonstrations of successful coordination (e.g., autonomous vehicles learning from human drivers); our few-shot baseline (Appendix F.7 ) is a first step in this direction. Finally, our analysis focuses on textual descriptions; extending it to Vision–Language Models (VLMs), which can leverage visual cues for coordination, is a natural direction for future work.

paragraphs.en: Prior work has evaluated LLM agents across a variety of multi-agent settings, including embodied interaction [ 31 , 61 , 20 ] , theory of mind (ToM) [ 36 , 30 , 51 ] , and games [ 62 , 58 , 57 ] . Closest to our setting, work on fully cooperative tasks has largely focused on spatial reasoning environments such as Overcooked [ 34 , 60 ] and mazes [ 10 ] , often relying on specialised scaffolds to achieve performance competitive with traditional RL methods. However, in the zero-shot coordination (ZSC) setting, independently developed agents are unlikely to share identical model-scaffold pairings, an implicit assumption in much of prior work, with [ 10 , 36 ] being notable exceptions. Moreover, the choice of the scaffold can substantially influence performance [ 39 ] , making it difficult to disentangle inherent model capabilities from scaffold-induced effects, a challenge that has been noted in other domains [ 18 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 先前的工作已在多种多智能体场景中对大语言模型（LLM）智能体进行了评估，包括具身交互 [ 31 , 61 , 20 ] 、心智理论（ToM）[ 36 , 30 , 51 ] 以及游戏 [ 62 , 58 , 57 ] 。 与我们的设定最接近的是，针对完全合作任务的研究主要聚焦于空间推理环境，如 Overcooked [ 34 , 60 ] 和迷宫 [ 10 ] ，且往往依赖专门的脚手架才能取得与传统强化学习方法相当的性能。 然而，在零样本协调（ZSC）设定中，各自独立开发的智能体不太可能共享相同的“模型—脚手架”组合，而这正是许多先前工作中的隐含假设，[ 10 , 36 ] 是值得一提的例外。 此外，脚手架的选择会显著影响性能 [ 39 ] ，这使得很难将模型固有能力与脚手架带来的效应区分开来，这一挑战在其他领域也已被指出 [ 18 ] 。

sents.en: Moreover, the choice of the scaffold can substantially influence performance [ 39 ] , making it difficult to disentangle inherent model capabilities from scaffold-induced effects, a challenge that has been noted in other domains [ 18 ] .

paragraphs.en: In contrast, a key advantage of using simplified environments, as in this work, is that they make failure modes explicit and easier to diagnose. In complex benchmarks such as Hanabi [ 6 ] , the core challenge is to communicate private information indirectly through actions and signals, which requires a combination of abilities, including theory of mind, convention formation, and long-horizon planning based on past interactions that can span dozens of timesteps. As a result, diagnosing coordination failures is challenging, as they may stem from deficiencies in any of the required abilities. Even among human players, post-game analysis involves reconstructing beliefs at each timestep of the game to identify where coordination broke down; doing so with LLM agents is even more challenging, given the difficulty of interpreting the reasons behind their actions. [ 1 ] attempt to address this by querying models at fixed game states with limited success. More recently, [ 48 ] benchmark LLM agents in Hanabi and report XP scores between different LLMs that improve with model strength. Their strongest agents average around 15 points, but rely on scaffolding with programmatic deductions and do not assign a score of zero to games that end after all life tokens are lost, which is the convention in prior ZSC work [ 6 ] . Even so, these agents remain well below experienced human players (20+) and state-of-the-art ZSC methods (24+) [ 14 ] , consistent with our findings. More broadly, complex environments require capabilities beyond coordination, for instance, strong planning in Hanabi or adequate state coverage in Overcooked [ 15 ] , making it difficult to explicitly test for coordination abilities.
paragraphs.zh: 相比之下，如本研究一样使用简化环境的一个关键优势在于，它们能使失败模式变得明确且更易于诊断。 在 Hanabi [ 6 ] 等复杂基准中，核心挑战是通过动作和信号间接传达私有信息，这需要多种能力的结合，包括心智理论、惯例形成，以及基于可跨越数十个时间步的过往交互进行的长程规划。 因此，诊断协作失败非常困难，因为失败可能源于上述任一所需能力的不足。 即使在人类玩家中，赛后分析也需要重建游戏中每个时间步的信念状态，以找出协作在哪里出了问题；而鉴于大语言模型智能体行动背后的原因难以解读，对其做这样的分析就更具挑战性。 [ 1 ] 尝试通过在固定的游戏状态下查询模型来解决这一问题，但收效有限。 最近，[ 48 ] 在 Hanabi 中对大语言模型智能体进行了基准测试，并报告了不同大语言模型之间的 XP 分数，发现分数随模型强度的提升而提高。 他们最强的智能体平均得分约为 15 分，但依赖于带有程序化推理的脚手架，并且在生命代币全部耗尽而结束的游戏中不记零分，而这是此前零样本协作（ZSC）工作的惯例 [ 6 ] 。 即便如此，这些智能体仍远低于有经验的人类玩家（20 分以上）和最先进的零样本协作方法（24 分以上）[ 14 ] ，这与我们的发现一致。 更广泛地说，复杂环境需要协作之外的能力，例如在 Hanabi 中需要强大的规划能力，在 Overcooked [ 15 ] 中需要充分的状态覆盖，这使得显式测试协作能力变得困难。

paragraphs.en: This work studies coordination among independently developed LLM agents in a zero-shot setting, characterising both their strengths and failure modes. Although insights into multi-agent coordination are dual-use in principle, our focus on fully cooperative simplified environments substantially limits the risk of misuse, and the proposed CFDs serve as an alignment-oriented mechanism for safer, more transparent coordination among independently developed agents.
paragraphs.zh: 本工作研究零样本设定下独立开发的LLM智能体之间的协作，刻画了它们的优势与失败模式。 尽管多智能体协作的洞见在原则上具有双重用途，但我们专注于完全合作性的简化环境，大幅限制了误用风险，且所提出的CFD作为一种面向对齐的机制，可促成独立开发的智能体之间更安全、更透明的协作。

paragraphs.en: We design a set of navigation challenges intended to capture the kinds of coordination challenges that arise in robotics and autonomous driving. A real-world example, documented in this video [ 13 ] , shows two Waymo vehicles hesitating at a narrow passage, each attempting to yield to the other. While such cautious behaviour is highly effective when interacting with proactive human drivers, it results in deadlock when both autonomous agents act symmetrically. More generally, navigation games highlight a central coordination problem: two symmetric players must “break symmetry” by adopting distinct, complementary roles in order to progress.
paragraphs.zh: 我们设计了一组导航挑战，旨在捕捉机器人技术和自动驾驶中出现的各类协调难题。 这段视频 [ 13 ] 中记录的真实案例显示，两辆 Waymo 车辆在一个狭窄通道前犹豫不前，都在试图给对方让行。 虽然这种谨慎的行为在与主动的人类驾驶员交互时非常有效，但当两个自主智能体以对称方式行动时，就会导致僵局。 更一般地说，导航博弈凸显了一个核心协调问题：两个对称的参与者必须通过承担不同且互补的角色来「打破对称」，才能取得进展。

paragraphs.en: formalises the coordination challenge illustrated in the above example. The environment consists of a tunnel, laid out left to right, with two agents positioned at opposite ends, tasked with exchanging positions in as few turns as possible. The setting is turn-based, with agents selecting actions simultaneously from the action set { LEFT , RIGHT , STAY } \{\texttt{LEFT},\texttt{RIGHT},\texttt{STAY}\} . The tunnel is composed of two types of tiles: wide tiles, which can accommodate both agents simultaneously, and narrow tiles, which can host at most a single agent.
paragraphs.zh: 将上述示例中展示的协调挑战形式化。 环境由一条从左到右布置的隧道组成，两个智能体分别位于两端，任务是以尽可能少的回合交换位置。 该设定为回合制，智能体从动作集合 { LEFT , RIGHT , STAY } \{\texttt{LEFT},\texttt{RIGHT},\texttt{STAY}\} 中同时选择动作。 隧道由两种类型的格子组成：宽格子可以同时容纳两个智能体，窄格子最多只能容纳一个智能体。

sents.zh: 隧道由两种类型的格子组成：宽格子可以同时容纳两个智能体，窄格子最多只能容纳一个智能体。

paragraphs.en: Collision rules restrict movement into narrow tiles. Specifically, (i) if two agents attempt to swap positions within a single turn and at least one of them occupies a narrow tile, the swap is blocked, and no movement occurs; (ii) if both agents attempt to enter the same narrow tile simultaneously, neither move is executed. Given these restrictions, at narrow points in the tunnel, agents must assume asymmetric roles to successfully traverse it (leader and follower). To incentivise minimising the number of turns, agents incur a per-step joint penalty of − 1 -1 until both agents have successfully exchanged positions.
paragraphs.zh: 碰撞规则限制进入狭窄格子的移动。 具体而言，(i) 若两个智能体试图在单个回合内交换位置，且其中至少一个智能体占据狭窄格子，则该交换被阻止，不发生任何移动；(ii) 若两个智能体试图同时进入同一个狭窄格子，则两个移动均不执行。 鉴于这些限制，在隧道中的狭窄点处，智能体必须承担非对称的角色才能成功通过（领导者和跟随者）。 为了激励最小化回合数，在两个智能体都成功交换位置之前，智能体每步承受 − 1 -1 的联合惩罚。

paragraphs.en: is inspired by cooperative platformer video games in which successful progression requires players to adopt complementary roles, such as one agent acting while the other temporarily waits. Although the assignment of such leader–follower roles is arbitrary, it is essential for successful task completion. Two agents are initially located on the same side of a bridge of length n n . Their joint objective is to traverse the bridge such that both agents reach the opposite side in the minimal number of turns. The environment is turn-based, with agents selecting actions simultaneously from the set { forward , backward , stay } \{\texttt{forward},\texttt{backward},\texttt{stay}\} . No collision constraints are imposed, so multiple agents may occupy the same tile at any given time. The coordination challenge stems from the bridge’s fragility. If both agents remain on the bridge, regardless of their exact positions, for more than a fixed number of consecutive turns, given by the parameter bridge_break_threshold (typically set to 1), the bridge collapses. When this happens, the episode ends and both agents receive a large negative reward of − 1000 -1000 . Importantly, the timer associated with the fragility constraint resets whenever at least one agent steps off the bridge. Consequently, when bridge_break_threshold equals 1, one agent may safely cross the bridge in its entirety while the other agent alternates between entering the first bridge tile and retreating to land, thereby preventing collapse. For our experiments, we fix n n to 5 and the bridge_break_threshold to 1. To incentivise minimising the number of turns, agents incur a per-step joint penalty of − 1 -1 until both agents have crossed the bridge.
paragraphs.zh: 其灵感来源于合作类平台电子游戏，在这类游戏中，成功推进需要玩家采取互补的角色，例如一个智能体行动而另一个智能体暂时等待。 尽管这种领导者—跟随者角色的分配是任意的，但对成功完成任务而言是必不可少的。 两个智能体最初位于长度为 n n 的桥的同一侧。 它们的共同目标是通过这座桥，使得两个智能体以最少的回合数到达对面。 该环境是基于回合的，智能体同时从集合 { forward , backward , stay } \{\texttt{forward},\texttt{backward},\texttt{stay}\} 中选择动作。 没有施加碰撞约束，因此多个智能体在任何给定时刻都可以占据同一个格子。 协调的挑战源于桥的脆弱性。 如果两个智能体在桥上（无论其具体位置如何）停留超过连续固定数量的回合，该数量由参数 bridge_break_threshold 给出（通常设为 1），桥就会坍塌。 当这种情况发生时，回合结束，两个智能体都会收到 − 1000 -1000 的大额负奖励。 重要的是，只要至少有一个智能体离开桥，与脆弱性约束相关联的计时器就会重置。 因此，当 bridge_break_threshold 等于 1 时，一个智能体可以安全地一次性通过整座桥，而另一个智能体则在进入第一个桥格与退回陆地之间交替，从而防止桥坍塌。 在我们的实验中，我们将 n n 固定为 5，将 bridge_break_threshold 固定为 1。 为了激励最小化回合数，在两个智能体都通过桥之前，每一步都会对它们施加 − 1 -1 的联合惩罚。

paragraphs.en: Convention games typically assign players fixed asymmetric roles and proceed sequentially. The coordination challenge arises from partial observability: the first player has access to some information that must be conveyed to the second player, who then makes a guess. To achieve a high reward, the players must establish a convention that maps possible signals to possible guesses.
paragraphs.zh: 惯例博弈通常为参与者分配固定的非对称角色，并按顺序进行。 协调挑战源于部分可观测性：第一个智能体掌握某些信息，必须将这些信息传达给第二个智能体，后者再进行猜测。 为了获得高奖励，各智能体必须建立一种将可能的信号映射到可能的猜测的惯例。

paragraphs.en: Inspired by [ 15 ] , we introduce games that require protocol formation at test time. Ad-Hoc Conventions is an iterated version of Cat & Dog. In contrast to the one-shot version discussed in the previous section, iteration enables the formation of conventions that can lead to guaranteed high payoffs in later rounds. We replace the animals with generic levers that can be assigned labels (in our case { blue , red } \{\texttt{blue},\texttt{red}\} ) and the lightbulb is replaced by labelled signals (in our case { square , circle } \{\texttt{square},\texttt{circle}\} ). Removing the wall is now represented by revealing the current correct lever. While we do not make further use of it in our experiments, we support an arbitrary number of signals and levers to increase the difficulty of the game. Additionally, the lever labels, signal labels, and the number of rounds can be specified as a hyperparameter. In our experiments, we play ten rounds per Ad-Hoc Conventions game.
paragraphs.zh: 受 [ 15 ] 启发，我们引入了需要在测试时形成协议的游戏。 Ad-Hoc Conventions 是 Cat & Dog 的迭代版本。 与上一节讨论的单次版本不同，迭代使得能够形成可以在后续轮次中带来有保障的高收益的约定。 我们将动物替换为可以被赋予标签的通用拉杆（在本例中为 { blue , red } \{\texttt{blue},\texttt{red}\} ），并将灯泡替换为带标签的信号（在本例中为 { square , circle } \{\texttt{square},\texttt{circle}\} ）。 移除墙壁现在表现为揭示当前正确的拉杆。 虽然我们在实验中并未进一步使用它，但我们支持任意数量的信号和拉杆以增加游戏难度。 此外，拉杆标签、信号标签和轮数都可以作为超参数来指定。 在我们的实验中，每个 Ad-Hoc Conventions 游戏进行十轮。

paragraphs.en: We also introduce a harder variant of Ad-Hoc Conventions, called Ad-Hoc Conventions with permuted signals (A.C.P.S.). Here we distinguish between buttons and signals , each with its own set of labels ( apple , banana {\texttt{apple},\texttt{banana}} and square , circle {\texttt{square},\texttt{circle}} in our case). The only change per round is that, instead of directly revealing a signal, Alice can now press one of the buttons (or choose reveal or bail), which then displays a signal to Bob. The connection between buttons and signals is given by a random bijection unknown to both players. Importantly, Alice does not see the resulting signal, and Bob does not see the pressed button. Without prior communication, it is therefore impossible to recover the exact bijection between signals and levers. Note that the button to signal mapping is fixed within the episode. As a result, the game cannot be solved through a simple lexicographical order strategy: Alice cannot know which button will trigger which signal for Bob. Nevertheless, in both the permuted and non-permuted versions, the players retain a simple fallback strategy, continuously revealing (i.e. removing the wall), which guarantees a reward of 5 per round, for a total “safe” return of 50 across the 10 rounds we typically consider in our experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还引入了一个更难的 Ad-Hoc Conventions 变体，称为带置换信号的 Ad-Hoc Conventions（A.C.P.S.）。 在这里我们区分按钮和信号，二者各有自己的标签集（在我们的设定中，按钮标签为 {\texttt{apple},\texttt{banana}}，信号标签为 {\texttt{square},\texttt{circle}}）。 每轮唯一的改动是，Alice 不再直接展示信号，而是可以按下其中一个按钮（或选择 reveal 或 bail），随后会向 Bob 显示一个信号。 按钮与信号之间的对应关系由一个双方都不知道的随机双射给出。 重要的是，Alice 看不到由此产生的信号，而 Bob 也看不到被按下的按钮。 因此，在没有事先沟通的情况下，无法恢复信号与拉杆之间的确切双射。 需要注意的是，按钮到信号的映射在单个回合序列（episode）内是固定的。 因此，该博弈无法通过简单的字典序策略求解：Alice 无法知道哪个按钮会为 Bob 触发哪个信号。 尽管如此，在带置换和不带置换的版本中，双方都保留了一个简单的兜底策略，即持续揭示（即移除墙壁），这能保证每轮获得 5 的奖励，在我们实验中通常考虑的 10 轮中总共可获得 50 的“安全”回报。

sents.en: Here we distinguish between buttons and signals , each with its own set of labels ( apple , banana {\texttt{apple},\texttt{banana}} and square , circle {\texttt{square},\texttt{circle}} in our case).
sents.zh: 在这里我们区分按钮和信号，二者各有自己的标签集（在我们的设定中，按钮标签为 {\texttt{apple},\texttt{banana}}，信号标签为 {\texttt{square},\texttt{circle}}）。

sents.en: The only change per round is that, instead of directly revealing a signal, Alice can now press one of the buttons (or choose reveal or bail), which then displays a signal to Bob.
sents.zh: 每轮唯一的改动是，Alice 不再直接展示信号，而是可以按下其中一个按钮（或选择 reveal 或 bail），随后会向 Bob 显示一个信号。

sents.en: The connection between buttons and signals is given by a random bijection unknown to both players.
sents.zh: 按钮与信号之间的对应关系由一个双方都不知道的随机双射给出。

sents.en: Importantly, Alice does not see the resulting signal, and Bob does not see the pressed button.
sents.zh: 重要的是，Alice 看不到由此产生的信号，而 Bob 也看不到被按下的按钮。

sents.en: Without prior communication, it is therefore impossible to recover the exact bijection between signals and levers.
sents.zh: 因此，在没有事先沟通的情况下，无法恢复信号与拉杆之间的确切双射。

sents.en: Note that the button to signal mapping is fixed within the episode.
sents.zh: 需要注意的是，按钮到信号的映射在单个回合序列（episode）内是固定的。

sents.en: As a result, the game cannot be solved through a simple lexicographical order strategy: Alice cannot know which button will trigger which signal for Bob.
sents.zh: 因此，该博弈无法通过简单的字典序策略求解：Alice 无法知道哪个按钮会为 Bob 触发哪个信号。

sents.en: Nevertheless, in both the permuted and non-permuted versions, the players retain a simple fallback strategy, continuously revealing (i.e. removing the wall), which guarantees a reward of 5 per round, for a total “safe” return of 50 across the 10 rounds we typically consider in our experiments.
sents.zh: 尽管如此，在带置换和不带置换的版本中，双方都保留了一个简单的兜底策略，即持续揭示（即移除墙壁），这能保证每轮获得 5 的奖励，在我们实验中通常考虑的 10 轮中总共可获得 50 的“安全”回报。

paragraphs.en: is a toy-game introduced in [ 12 ] . It consists of two players, who are each dealt a random card at the start of the game. The final joint reward depends on both the players’ cards and their actions throughout the game. The second player observes the first player’s actions before picking his action, which allows the first player’s action to be interpreted as a signal. We show the payoff matrix of Tiny Hanabi in Figure 10 . Due to the asymmetry of the payoff matrix, the original version of Tiny Hanabi has a unique SP optimal policy, yielding a joint reward of 10. This policy is given by the first player picking action A A if he has card 2 and C C otherwise, with the second player responding accordingly. To see why it is unique, note that a joint reward of 10 requires that neither player ever plays B B , and that the second player conditions on the first player’s action, since no column of the payoff matrices consists entirely of 10s. The first player must therefore play different actions for the two cards. If the first player instead plays C C with card 2 while the second player holds card 1, the joint reward is 0 regardless of the second player’s response. Hence, the first player must map card 2 to A A and card 1 to C C . In Tiny Hanabi Fixed, the second player could respond to this case with C C and still obtain a reward of 10, which gives rise to two symmetric SP-optimal policies.
paragraphs.zh: 是 [12] 中介绍的一个玩具游戏。 它由两名玩家组成，每名玩家在游戏开始时被发一张随机牌。 最终的联合奖励取决于双方的牌以及他们在整个游戏中的动作。 第二名玩家在选择自己的动作之前会观察到第一名玩家的动作，这使得第一名玩家的动作可以被解读为一个信号。 我们在图 10 中展示了 Tiny Hanabi 的收益矩阵。 由于收益矩阵的不对称性，Tiny Hanabi 的原始版本拥有唯一的 SP 最优策略，可产生 10 的联合奖励。 该策略为：第一名玩家在持有牌 2 时选择动作 A A，否则选择 C C，而第二名玩家相应地做出回应。 至于为什么该策略是唯一的，请注意，要获得 10 的联合奖励，需要两名玩家都不出 B B，且第二名玩家依据第一名玩家的动作进行条件决策，因为收益矩阵的任何一列都不全为 10。 因此，第一名玩家必须对两张牌采取不同的动作。 如果第一名玩家在持有牌 2 且第二名玩家持有牌 1 的情况下改为出 C C，那么无论第二名玩家如何回应，联合奖励都是 0。 因此，第一名玩家必须将牌 2 映射到 A A，将牌 1 映射到 C C。 在 Tiny Hanabi Fixed 中，第二名玩家可以用 C C 来回应这种情况并仍然获得 10 的奖励，从而产生了两个对称的 SP 最优策略。

paragraphs.en: To create a version of Tiny Hanabi with a coordination challenge, we symmetrize the payoff matrix, also shown in Figure 10 . As in the previous convention games, there is a safe fallback option, which does not require any conventions: Playing B B as the first player leads to a reward of 8 8 as long as the second player responds rationally. Hence Tiny Hanabi Fixed is similar to Cat & Dog wherein there exists two symmetrical conventions with identical payoffs and a safe fallback option.

paragraphs.en: In the standard game of Hanabi, each colour has a deck of 10 cards: three 1s, two 2s, two 3s, two 4s, and one 5, for a total of 50 cards across 5 colours. The game is fully cooperative and features 5 ranks and 5 colours, with each card defined by a rank–colour pair. Players share a limited pool of 3 life tokens and 8 hint tokens. At the start, each player is dealt 5 cards; crucially, players cannot see their own hands but can observe those of their teammates. The objective is to build “fireworks” by stacking cards of each colour in increasing rank order. On each turn, a player may either play a card, discard a card, or provide a hint to another player. Hints can specify either a rank or a colour, indicating all cards of that type in the recipient’s hand, and each hint consumes one token. An incorrect play—i.e., one that cannot be placed on the fireworks—costs a life token. Discarding a card restores a hint token, up to the maximum. After playing or discarding, the player draws a new card from the deck, maintaining a constant hand size while cards remain. Players receive +1 for each correctly played card, and the game ends with a score of 0 if all life tokens are lost.
paragraphs.zh: 在标准的花火游戏中，每种颜色有一副10张的牌：三张1、两张2、两张3、两张4和一张5，5种颜色共计50张牌。 该游戏是完全合作型的，包含5个点数和5种颜色，每张牌由一个点数–颜色对定义。 玩家共享一个有限的资源池，包含3个生命令牌和8个提示令牌。 游戏开始时，每位玩家发到5张牌；关键在于，玩家不能看到自己的手牌，但可以观察到队友的手牌。 游戏目标是通过将每种颜色的牌按点数递增的顺序堆叠来构建「烟花」。 在每个回合中，玩家可以选择出一张牌、弃掉一张牌，或给另一名玩家提供提示。 提示可以指定一个点数或一种颜色，指出接收者手牌中所有该类型的牌，且每次提示消耗一个令牌。 一次错误的出牌——即无法放置到烟花上的牌——会损失一个生命令牌。 弃掉一张牌可以恢复一个提示令牌，上限为最大值。 出牌或弃牌后，玩家从牌堆中抽一张新牌，只要牌堆中还有牌，就保持手牌数量恒定。 玩家每正确打出一张牌得+1分，若所有生命令牌耗尽，游戏以0分结束。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we consider a simplified 3×3 variant with 3 colours and 3 ranks, where each colour has three 1s, two 2s, and one 3, for a total maximum score of 9. The game includes a single life token and a limit of 3 hint tokens. The central challenge of Hanabi arises from the limited and costly communication channel provided by hints. Effective play therefore requires agents to use hints efficiently, often relying on implicit conventions to convey information about hidden states to their partners.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们考虑一个简化的 3×3 变体，包含 3 种颜色和 3 种点数，其中每种颜色有三张 1、两张 2 和一张 3，总最高得分为 9。 游戏包含一个生命令牌和 3 个提示令牌的上限。 Hanabi 的核心挑战源自提示所提供的有限且代价高昂的通信渠道。 因此，有效的游戏要求智能体高效地使用提示，往往需要依赖隐式约定向队友传达关于隐藏状态的信息。

paragraphs.en: In simultaneous selection games , symmetric players have to coordinate on one of many similar, often symmetric, choices to achieve a high joint reward. We study both one-shot versions of these games ( Matrix Game ) and iterated versions ( Permuted Levers ).
paragraphs.zh: 在同时选择博弈中，对称的参与者必须在众多相似且往往对称的选择中协调于其中一个，才能获得较高的联合奖励。 我们同时研究了这些博弈的单次版本（矩阵博弈）和迭代版本（置换拉杆）。

paragraphs.en: Lever Games are common in ZSC literature [ 24 , 55 ] . For our purposes, we focus on iterated versions of lever games with n n levers all with identical payoff. In each round, both players simultaneously chose one of the levers. If players manage to pick the same lever, they receive a joint reward of 1. To prevent arbitrary focal points introduced by numbering the levers (which is needed for the LLM agents to interact with the environment), we introduce a further complication inspired by the other-play objective [ 23 ] : Each player observes and acts on the levers through a random permutation of the lever numbers, which stays fixed across the rounds of the game. While players are aware of the fact, they do not know their own or others’ permutations.
paragraphs.zh: 杠杆博弈在 ZSC 文献中很常见 [ 24 , 55 ] 。 就本文而言，我们关注的是具有 n n 个杠杆且所有杠杆收益相同的杠杆博弈的迭代版本。 在每一轮中，双方智能体同时选择其中一个杠杆。 如果双方智能体成功选择了同一个杠杆，他们将获得 1 的联合奖励。 为了避免给杠杆编号而引入任意的显著焦点（而编号是 LLM 智能体与环境交互所必需的），我们受 other-play 目标 [ 23 ] 的启发引入了一个更复杂的设计：每个智能体通过杠杆编号的一个随机置换来观察并作用于这些杠杆，该置换在整个博弈的各轮中保持固定。 虽然智能体知晓这一事实，但他们并不知道自己的或他人的置换。

paragraphs.en: Our version of the Matrix Game was introduced by [ 35 ] . In this game, two players simultaneously choose a row/column and receive the reward in the selected cell. The matrix used to play this game is shown in Figure 11 . For humans, there is an easy-to-identify focal point given by the first column and first/second row, which can be exploited. Our version of the matrix game uses a 11 × 11 11\times 11 matrix extending the diagonal pattern by 1. This yields another possible focal point at the middle of the diagonal pattern (see also Figure 39 ). Matrix game differs from the other coordination challenges presented in this section in that there is no salient policy that could be considered “ZSC-optimal”. Successful coordination in the matrix game largely depends on players forming the same arbitrary conventions to form a focal point in the matrix, exactly the inverse of what ZSC is trying to achieve. Therefore, we have chosen to exclude Matrix game from the main experiments of the paper, but report results for completeness in Appendix F.2 and Appendix F.3 .

paragraphs.en: demonstrate that the addition of semantics can create coordination challenges in games that previously did not exhibit them, as they have a unique SP optimal policy. In particular, the semantic games presented in this paper, the semantic selection game ( Figure 5 ) and the semantic convention game ( Figure 12 ), force players to choose between two mutually incompatible meta-strategies: either playing the SP optimal strategy or following a strategy that is aligned with the game semantics. Figure 3 has demonstrated that LLM agents often struggle to consistently interpret semantics and fail to properly reason about these difficulties. Semantic games, on the other hand, show that even when the semantic interpretation is clear across agents, semantics can still hinder the coordination abilities of agents, just by the fact that they introduce another possible meta-strategy.

paragraphs.en: The hint-guess game was introduced in [ 37 ] to study whether agents can exploit shared semantic structure between actions and observations for zero-shot coordination. The game involves two players, a hinter and a guesser , each dealt a hand of N N cards, where every card is described by two discrete features. One card from the guesser’s hand is secretly designated the target, and its identity is revealed only to the hinter. The hinter must select a card from their own hand to show the guesser; the guesser then picks which card in their hand corresponds to the target. Both players receive a reward of 1 1 if the guess is correct and 0 0 otherwise. The environment is visualised in Figure 14 . Interestingly, implicatures [ 38 , 17 ] represent sophisticated patterns of human reasoning, making them a compelling test of whether LLM agents can exhibit similar capabilities. As shown in Table 8 , text agents consistently exhibit human-like reasoning and, notably, demonstrate the ability to coordinate via implicatures.

paragraphs.en: In addition to reporting joint rewards, we measure the coordination failure rate, which captures the frequency of catastrophic coordination failures arising from paired local policies. For example, in Tiny Hanabi, a grounded joint policy that consistently reaches ( B , B ) (B,B) achieves a guaranteed reward of 8 8 . In contrast, we observe paired policies that attain the maximum reward of 10 10 in 80 % 80\% of episodes but receive a reward of 0 0 in the remaining 20 % 20\% , resulting in the same XP score. Despite the same average score, the grounded policy is clearly more robust. To capture this, we report coordination failure rates. An episode is classified as a failure if the agents’ joint reward is at or below the threshold specified in Table 2 .

paragraphs.en: We report the SP scores of the text agents with and without the hand-crafted CFD in the fixed LLM setting for Grok 4.1 Fast and GPT-5.2 in Table 1 . We find that the agents exhibit high coordination failure rates and low SP scores across multiple environments, indicating poor coordination. Introducing the hand-crafted CFD improves coordination in several environments, with a larger effect on Grok 4.1 Fast than on GPT-5.2. However, as discussed in Appendix F.3 , the CFD can be overly restrictive. This is also evident in Brittle Bridge, where agents enter a deadlock, each waiting for the other to step onto the bridge to avoid collapse.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在表 1 中报告了在固定 LLM 设置下，文本智能体在使用与不使用手工设计 CFD 情况下针对 Grok 4.1 Fast 和 GPT-5.2 的 SP 分数。 我们发现，这些智能体在多个环境中表现出高协调失败率和低 SP 分数，表明协调能力不佳。 引入手工设计的 CFD 在若干环境中改善了协调效果，且对 Grok 4.1 Fast 的影响大于对 GPT-5.2 的影响。 然而，正如附录 F.3 中所讨论的，CFD 可能过于严格。 这在 Brittle Bridge 中也很明显：智能体陷入僵局，彼此都在等待对方先踏上桥以避免坍塌。
