paragraphs.en: We report the SP and XP scores of the code agents under both the fixed LLM setting (denoted XP seed \text{XP}_{\text{seed}} ) and the variable LLM setting (denoted XP LLM \text{XP}_{\text{LLM}} ) in Table 6 . The scores are calculated as follows. First, we generate six independent cross-play matrices, with each LLM contributing one joint policy to each matrix. Every joint-policy pairing is evaluated over 100 episodes. We then average scores across the six XP matrices to obtain a single ( N LLM × N LLM ) (N_{\text{LLM}}\times N_{\text{LLM}}) matrix. For SP, we report the mean and standard error over the diagonal entries. For variable-LLM XP LLM \text{XP}_{\text{LLM}} , we compute the mean and standard error over the off-diagonal entries in each LLM ′ s corresponding row and column. For fixed-LLM XP seed \text{XP}_{\text{seed}} , we pair joint policies produced by the same LLM across different XP matrices into disjoint pairs (e.g., ( 1 , 2 ) (1,2) , ( 3 , 4 ) (3,4) , …), evaluate each pair jointly, and report the resulting mean and standard error. We do the same when reporting the coordination failure rates in Table 7 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在表 6 中报告了代码智能体在固定 LLM 设置（记为 XP seed \text{XP}_{\text{seed}} ）和可变 LLM 设置（记为 XP LLM \text{XP}_{\text{LLM}} ）下的 SP 与 XP 分数。 分数的计算方式如下。 首先，我们生成六个独立的交叉博弈矩阵，每个 LLM 为每个矩阵贡献一个联合策略。 每个联合策略配对都在 100 个回合上进行评估。 随后，我们在六个 XP 矩阵上取分数的平均值，得到一个单一的 ( N LLM × N LLM ) (N_{\text{LLM}}\times N_{\text{LLM}}) 矩阵。 对于 SP，我们报告对角线元素的均值和标准误。 对于可变 LLM 的 XP LLM \text{XP}_{\text{LLM}} ，我们计算每个 LLM 对应行和列中非对角线元素的均值和标准误。 对于固定 LLM 的 XP seed \text{XP}_{\text{seed}} ，我们将同一 LLM 在不同 XP 矩阵中产生的联合策略配成不相交的对（例如 ( 1 , 2 ) (1,2) 、 ( 3 , 4 ) (3,4) 等），对每一对进行联合评估，并报告所得的均值和标准误。 我们在报告表 7 中的协调失败率时也采用同样的做法。

paragraphs.en: The tiger trampoline game, shown in 17(a) , is a coordination game introduced in [ 25 ] to illustrate the concept of self-explaining deviations (SED) . A self-explaining deviation is an action by a teammate in a fully cooperative setting that, at first, appears to hurt the team’s performance. But if players act under the belief that their teammates’ actions are rational, those actions can signal hidden information to them, ultimately aiding the team. In the trampoline tiger game, Bob controls a lever that can release a hidden object: either a tiger or a trampoline. Alice stands above and can observe the hidden state, but cannot communicate further with Bob. She has the option to jump, which yields only a small positive joint reward if the hidden state is the trampoline and Bob pulls the lever. Bob can observe whether Alice jumps before pulling the lever. If Alice acts rationally, she will only decide to jump if the hidden state is a trampoline, thereby signalling it to Bob. Notably, never jumping and never pulling the lever is a pure Nash equilibrium. Therefore, algorithms that independently learn Alice’s and Bob’s policies risk getting stuck in this local maximum. Hu et al. [25] showed that popular MARL algorithms like MAPPO [ 59 ] and QMIX [ 49 ] converge to this Nash Equilibrium in most cases. LLM agents naturally consider bilateral deviations of Alice’s and Bob’s actions by directly reasoning about the environment dynamics. As shown in 17(b) , this allows a variety of LLM agents to determine the optimal policy in this game.
paragraphs.zh: 图17(a)所示的跳板老虎博弈是一个协调博弈，由[25]引入，用来说明自我解释偏离（SED）的概念。 自我解释偏离是指在完全合作的环境中，队友做出的一个动作，乍看之下似乎会损害团队的表现。 但如果玩家在相信队友的行为是理性的前提下行动，这些动作就可以向他们传递隐藏信息，最终帮助团队。 在跳板老虎博弈中，Bob控制一个可以释放隐藏物体的拉杆：该物体要么是一只老虎，要么是一块跳板。 Alice站在上方，可以观察到隐藏状态，但无法与Bob进一步沟通。 她可以选择跳跃，只有在隐藏状态为跳板且Bob拉动拉杆时，跳跃才会带来较小的正联合奖励。 Bob可以在拉动拉杆之前观察Alice是否跳跃。 如果Alice理性行事，只有在隐藏状态为跳板时她才会决定跳跃，从而向Bob传递这一信号。 值得注意的是，从不跳跃且从不拉动拉杆是一个纯纳什均衡。 因此，独立学习Alice和Bob策略的算法有可能陷入这个局部最大值。Hu等人 [25]表明，MAPPO[59]和QMIX[49]等流行的MARL算法在大多数情况下都会收敛到这个纳什均衡。 LLM智能体通过直接对环境动态进行推理，自然会考虑Alice和Bob动作的双边偏离。 如图17(b)所示，这使得多种LLM智能体都能在该博弈中确定最优策略。

paragraphs.en: Since text agents interact with the environment by producing actions sequentially, rather than explicitly specifying joint policies as code, their decision-making is less interpretable. To better understand their behaviour, we empirically estimate their induced local policies.
paragraphs.zh: 由于文本智能体通过依次产生动作与环境交互，而不是以代码形式显式指定联合策略，其决策过程的可解释性较低。 为了更好地理解它们的行为，我们对它们所诱导出的局部策略进行了实证估计。

sents.en: Since text agents interact with the environment by producing actions sequentially, rather than explicitly specifying joint policies as code, their decision-making is less interpretable.
sents.zh: 由于文本智能体通过依次产生动作与环境交互，而不是以代码形式显式指定联合策略，其决策过程的可解释性较低。

sents.en: To better understand their behaviour, we empirically estimate their induced local policies.
sents.zh: 为了更好地理解它们的行为，我们对它们所诱导出的局部策略进行了实证估计。

paragraphs.en: We estimate the local policies p alice ( ⋅ ∣ animal ) p_{\text{alice}}(\cdot\mid\text{animal}) and p bob ( ⋅ ∣ a alice ) p_{\text{bob}}(\cdot\mid a_{\text{alice}}) by fixing the environment state and repeatedly prompting the agent 100 100 times as shown in Figure 18 . Next, we study how these local policies change under variations in the game’s semantics 𝒟 \mathcal{D} . To this end, we consider three variants: (1) replacing the binary light-bulb signal ( “on/off” ) with a colour choice ( “red/blue” ), (2) translating the natural-language descriptions into German, (3) the agent is informed that it is being evaluated against an identical instance of itself.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过固定环境状态并如图 18 所示反复提示智能体 100 次，来估计局部策略 p_alice(·|animal) 和 p_bob(·|a_alice)。 接下来，我们研究这些局部策略在博弈语义 𝒟 发生变化时如何变化。 为此，我们考虑三种变体：(1) 将二元的灯泡信号（“开/关”）替换为颜色选择（“红/蓝”），(2) 将自然语言描述翻译成德语，(3) 告知智能体它正在与一个与自身完全相同的实例进行评估。

sents.zh: 我们通过固定环境状态并如图 18 所示反复提示智能体 100 次，来估计局部策略 p_alice(·|animal) 和 p_bob(·|a_alice)。

sents.zh: 为此，我们考虑三种变体：(1) 将二元的灯泡信号（“开/关”）替换为颜色选择（“红/蓝”），(2) 将自然语言描述翻译成德语，(3) 告知智能体它正在与一个与自身完全相同的实例进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Note that the agent is given complete information about the Dec-POMDP structure, including the payoffs. Consequently, the natural-language description of the MDP should not affect the induced local policy as long as the underlying Dec-POMDP structure is preserved, with the exception of the final setting, in which the agent has the option to use a convention to maximise reward. Despite this, we observe substantial differences in the induced local policies across semantic variants, as shown in Figure 18 . In particular, the SP variant leads to a drastic reduction in XP scores, as discussed in Figure 3 .
paragraphs.zh: 请注意，智能体可以获得关于 Dec-POMDP 结构的完整信息，包括收益。 因此，只要底层 Dec-POMDP 结构保持不变，MDP 的自然语言描述就不应影响所诱导的局部策略，唯一例外是最后一种设置，在该设置中智能体可以选择使用约定来最大化奖励。 尽管如此，如图 18 所示，我们观察到不同语义变体所诱导的局部策略存在显著差异。 其中，SP 变体导致 XP 得分大幅下降，如图 3 所讨论的那样。

paragraphs.en: We also probe whether model internals, specifically token-level action probabilities and chain-of-thought reasoning tokens, are consistent with the empirical local policies and the explicit reasoning outputs elicited before each action. We focus on open-weight models that expose these internals: OLMo-3-32B-Think, Qwen3-14B, and Ministral-14B.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还探究了模型内部状态——具体来说是词元级别的动作概率和思维链推理词元——是否与经验局部策略以及在每步动作之前诱导出的显式推理输出保持一致。 我们关注能暴露这些内部状态的开放权重模型：OLMo-3-32B-Think、Qwen3-14B 和 Ministral-14B。

sents.en: We also probe whether model internals, specifically token-level action probabilities and chain-of-thought reasoning tokens, are consistent with the empirical local policies and the explicit reasoning outputs elicited before each action.
sents.zh: 我们还探究了模型内部状态——具体来说是词元级别的动作概率和思维链推理词元——是否与经验局部策略以及在每步动作之前诱导出的显式推理输出保持一致。

sents.en: We focus on open-weight models that expose these internals: OLMo-3-32B-Think, Qwen3-14B, and Ministral-14B.
sents.zh: 我们关注能暴露这些内部状态的开放权重模型：OLMo-3-32B-Think、Qwen3-14B 和 Ministral-14B。

paragraphs.en: To estimate token-level action probabilities, we compute the log-probability of each legal action completion under a fixed prompt and normalise across legal actions using a softmax. This requires disabling chain-of-thought reasoning, since reasoning tokens precede the action token and would otherwise confound the estimate. We find that disabling reasoning substantially degrades policy quality: models such as OLMo-3-32B-Think and Qwen3-14B, which exhibit strong empirical local policies when reasoning is enabled, produce markedly worse token-level policies in this setting ( Figure 19 ), an effect we attribute to the removal of the reasoning step.
paragraphs.zh: 为了估计词元级别的动作概率，我们在固定的提示词下计算每个合法动作补全的对数概率，并通过 softmax 在合法动作之间进行归一化。 这需要禁用思维链推理，因为推理词元位于动作词元之前，否则会干扰该估计。 我们发现禁用推理会显著降低策略质量：诸如 OLMo-3-32B-Think 和 Qwen3-14B 这类在启用推理时表现出较强经验局部策略的模型，在此设置下产生的词元级别策略明显更差（图 19），我们将这一效应归因于推理步骤的移除。

paragraphs.en: When reasoning is re-enabled, the generated chain-of-thought tokens closely match the content of the explicit reasoning outputs, indicating that the reasoning is faithful to the model’s decision process. This supports the validity of our reasoning-based analysis for closed-weight models such as GPT-5.2, for which token-level internals are inaccessible.
paragraphs.zh: 当重新启用推理时，生成的思维链词元与显式推理输出的内容高度一致，表明推理忠实于模型的决策过程。 这为我们针对 GPT-5.2 等无法访问词元级内部信息的闭权重模型所开展的基于推理的分析提供了有效性支持。

sents.en: When reasoning is re-enabled, the generated chain-of-thought tokens closely match the content of the explicit reasoning outputs, indicating that the reasoning is faithful to the model’s decision process.
sents.zh: 当重新启用推理时，生成的思维链词元与显式推理输出的内容高度一致，表明推理忠实于模型的决策过程。

sents.en: This supports the validity of our reasoning-based analysis for closed-weight models such as GPT-5.2, for which token-level internals are inaccessible.
sents.zh: 这为我们针对 GPT-5.2 等无法访问词元级内部信息的闭权重模型所开展的基于推理的分析提供了有效性支持。

paragraphs.en: As noted earlier, coordination requires reasoning about a partner’s behaviour (ToM). In formal reasoning tasks, increasing reasoning effort, i.e the budget of reasoning tokens available, often yields substantial performance gains. We therefore examine how varying reasoning effort affects the performance of text agents, as reported in Table 3 . Surprisingly, for the smaller models (Grok 4.1 Fast and GPT-5 Mini), reasoning effort is negatively correlated with XP score. Further analysis shows that higher reasoning effort increases the likelihood that these models hallucinate a shared convention and assume that their partner will adopt the same convention. That said, we find that the hand-crafted CFD facilitates robust coordination even under increased reasoning effort.
paragraphs.zh: 如前所述，协调需要对合作者的行为进行推理（心智理论，ToM）。 在形式推理任务中，增加推理力度（即可用的推理 token 预算）通常会带来显著的性能提升。 因此，我们考察了不同的推理力度对文本智能体性能的影响，结果见表 3。 令人惊讶的是，对于较小的模型（Grok 4.1 Fast 和 GPT-5 Mini），推理力度与 XP 分数呈负相关。 进一步分析表明，更高的推理力度会增加这些模型幻觉出共享约定并假定其合作者会采用相同约定的可能性。 尽管如此，我们发现手工设计的 CFD 即使在推理力度增加的情况下也能实现稳健的协调。

paragraphs.en: We additionally evaluate frontier models (GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Opus 5, and Grok 4.5) as text agents in Cat & Dog ( Table 4 ). In contrast to the smaller models, increasing reasoning effort improves the reveal rate for all three, most strongly for Claude Opus 5 (from 0 % 0\% to 74 % 74\% ). At the same time, we observe degradation within model families: Qwen3-Max-Thinking performs worse than Qwen3-14B, and GPT-5.6 Sol reveals far less often than GPT-5.2 ( Table 4 and Figure 3 ), despite being positioned as a substantial advance in overall capability. Taken together, these results suggest a mixed relationship between reasoning capacity and ZSC performance : more capable models or higher reasoning effort do not reliably translate into stronger zero-shot coordination.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还评估了前沿模型（GPT-5.6 Sol、Claude Opus 5 和 Grok 4.5）作为文本智能体在 Cat & Dog 中的表现（表 4）。 与较小的模型相反，提高推理努力（reasoning effort）能提升所有这三个模型的揭示率，其中 Claude Opus 5 提升最大（从 0% 到 74%）。 与此同时，我们观察到模型家族内部的退化：Qwen3-Max-Thinking 的表现差于 Qwen3-14B，而 GPT-5.6 Sol 的揭示频率远低于 GPT-5.2（表 4 和图 3），尽管 GPT-5.6 Sol 被定位为整体能力上的重大进步。 综合来看，这些结果表明推理能力与 ZSC 表现之间存在复杂的关系：更强的模型或更高的推理努力并不一定能可靠地转化为更强的零样本协调能力。

sents.en: In contrast to the smaller models, increasing reasoning effort improves the reveal rate for all three, most strongly for Claude Opus 5 (from 0 % 0\% to 74 % 74\% ).

sents.en: At the same time, we observe degradation within model families: Qwen3-Max-Thinking performs worse than Qwen3-14B, and GPT-5.6 Sol reveals far less often than GPT-5.2 ( Table 4 and Figure 3 ), despite being positioned as a substantial advance in overall capability.

sents.en: Taken together, these results suggest a mixed relationship between reasoning capacity and ZSC performance : more capable models or higher reasoning effort do not reliably translate into stronger zero-shot coordination.
sents.zh: 综合来看，这些结果表明推理能力与 ZSC 表现之间存在复杂的关系：更强的模型或更高的推理努力并不一定能可靠地转化为更强的零样本协调能力。

paragraphs.en: A simple alternative to coordination-friendly definitions is to provide agents with in-context demonstrations of successful coordination. Whereas a CFD states the principles underlying successful coordination explicitly, an agent learning from demonstrations must first infer these principles implicitly before transferring them to an unseen environment. To compare the two, we rerun the Cat & Dog XP experiment from Figure 1 with prompts augmented by examples of successful coordination from three other environments. For each, we include the environment description and a hand-crafted rollout of the ZSC-optimal strategy: establishing and maintaining a stable convention across rounds in Ad-Hoc Conventions; selecting the safe fallback ( B , B ) (B,B) in Tiny Hanabi Fixed, whose payoff structure closely resembles Cat & Dog; and avoiding bridge collapse by retreating when both players enter the bridge, while establishing an ad-hoc leader–follower convention, in Brittle Bridge. As Grok 4.1 Fast had been deprecated by the time of this experiment, we replace it with Grok 4.5 and regenerate the full XP matrices for all three settings. As shown in Table 5 , only the CFD enables reliable coordination across all pairs of agents. While the small sample size makes it difficult to determine whether few-shot demonstrations provide any marginal benefit, they perform substantially worse than the CFD.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate whether text agents can match human actions, which requires human-like reasoning patterns such as implicatures [ 38 , 17 ] . The results, reported in Table 8 , show that LLM agents are able to align with human-like reasoning, achieving performance comparable to state-of-the-art methods [ 37 ] (Table 2).

paragraphs.en: We report the cross-LLM and scaffold generalization scores of the meta-learned CFD in Figure 22 and Figure 23 .

paragraphs.en: We outline the algorithm used in our pareto-evolution meta-learning loop in Algorithms 1 , 2 , and 3 . The algorithm is roughly based on GEPA [ 2 ] , implementing both pareto-based candidate selection and the cheap pre-filtering of new CFDs. Still, there are notable differences to GEPA. In particular, GEPA cannot be applied directly to the ZSC setting as the number of environments is generally far smaller than the number of “tasks” assumed in GEPA. Compared to GEPA, we therefore compute the actual pareto frontier in Algorithm 2 across our meta-train set, without any previous task-wise elite filtering. We also adopt a caching mechanism for the set of initial policies used in each scoring step. This significantly reduces the costs of running the meta-loop. Additionally, by using the same set of initial policies when comparing CFDs, we significantly reduce the variance in XP-scores (as we eliminate the source of variance from the initial generation step), which generally leads to a more stable meta-loop. At last, the meta-loop differs in the used mutation operators. Similar to GEPA, we tried to include environment feedback into the mutation operators used in the meta-loop, both through direct or obfuscated conditioning on observed coordination failures. In general, we found that the inclusion of such operators unhelpful, often leading to either overfitting or low-quality uni-modal proposals. Instead, we found that ensuring the creation of diverse proposals in the mutation operators was of key importance to the success of the meta-loop. To facilitate such proposals, we apply the following modifications: Mutation operators generally prompt an LLM for a specific kind of modification of the CFD instead of leaving the modification to the LLM. This is similar to the mutation prompts used in PromptBreeder [ 11 ] . In our case, the LLM is prompted to either add, remove, reformulate, or freely modify a bullet point in the CFD. Orthogonal to this, we found that prompting an LLM for a set of diverse proposals and then sampling the final proposal uniformly at random from this set can significantly increase diversity, as it allows us to sample proposals from the long tail, which would normally not make it into the LLM’s first response. These two axes yield a total of eight mutation operators. We also add the re-initialization of CFDs as an additional mutation operator.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在第1、2、3号算法中概述了帕累托进化元学习循环所使用的算法。 该算法大致基于GEPA [2]，同时实现了基于帕累托的候选选择以及对新CFD的廉价预过滤。 尽管如此，它与GEPA仍存在显著差异。 特别是，GEPA无法直接应用于ZSC设定，因为环境的数量通常远小于GEPA中所假设的“任务”数量。 因此，与GEPA相比，我们在算法2中直接在元训练集上计算实际的帕累托前沿，而不进行任何先前的逐任务精英过滤。 我们还为每个评分步骤中所使用的初始策略集合采用了缓存机制。 这显著降低了运行元循环的成本。 此外，通过在比较CFD时使用同一组初始策略，我们显著降低了XP分数的方差（因为我们消除了来自初始生成步骤的方差来源），这通常会使元循环更加稳定。 最后，元循环的不同之处在于所使用的变异算子。 与GEPA类似，我们曾尝试将环境反馈纳入元循环中使用的变异算子，包括通过对观察到的协调失败进行直接或混淆式的条件化。 总体而言，我们发现纳入此类算子并无帮助，往往导致过拟合或低质量的单模态提案。 相反，我们发现确保变异算子生成多样化的提案，对元循环的成功至关重要。 为了促成此类提案，我们应用了以下修改：变异算子通常提示LLM对CFD进行特定类型的修改，而不是将修改方式留给LLM自行决定。 这类似于PromptBreeder [11] 中使用的变异提示。 在我们的情况下，LLM被提示对CFD中的某个要点执行添加、删除、重新表述或自由修改操作。 与此正交的是，我们发现提示LLM生成一组多样化的提案，然后从该集合中均匀随机采样最终提案，可以显著提高多样性，因为这使我们能够从长尾中采样提案，而这些提案通常不会出现在LLM的首次回复中。 这两个维度共产生了八种变异算子。 我们还将CFD的重新初始化作为额外的变异算子加入其中。

paragraphs.en: The prompt templates used by the mutation operators in our meta-learning loop are shown in Figure 27 , Figure 28 , Figure 29 , Figure 30 , and Figure 31 . All mutation prompts begin with the shared background block in Figure 27 . The four unary_* operators ( add , remove , reformulate , atomic ) share the template in Figure 28 ; the thinking-style block from Figure 29 specifies which atomic edit the LLM is asked to perform. The four diverse_* operators reuse the same thinking-style blocks but ask for n proposals n_{\text{proposals}} diverse candidates per call ( Figure 30 ); we then sample one proposal uniformly at random. The reinit operator generates fresh single-bullet CFDs from scratch using the seed template in Figure 31 .

paragraphs.en: The reviewers of your paper will be asked to use the checklist as one of the factors in their evaluation. While the questions are phrased in a binary way, we acknowledge that the true answer is often more nuanced, so please just use your best judgment and write a justification to elaborate. All supporting evidence can appear either in the main paper or the supplemental material, provided in appendix. paragraphs.en: Question: Do the main claims made in the abstract and introduction accurately reflect the paper’s contributions and scope?

paragraphs.en: Justification: Empirical claims are supported by experiments in Figure 3 , Section 5 , and Section 6 , with additional results in Appendix F.3 . sents.en: Justification: Empirical claims are supported by experiments in Figure 3 , Section 5 , and Section 6 , with additional results in Appendix F.3 .

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the abstract and introduction do not include the claims made in the paper.

paragraphs.en: The abstract and/or introduction should clearly state the claims made, including the contributions made in the paper and important assumptions and limitations. A [No] or [N/A] answer to this question will not be perceived well by the reviewers.

sents.en: The abstract and/or introduction should clearly state the claims made, including the contributions made in the paper and important assumptions and limitations.
sents.zh: 摘要和/或引言应清楚地陈述论文所提出的主张，包括论文做出的贡献以及重要的假设和局限性。

sents.en: A [No] or [N/A] answer to this question will not be perceived well by the reviewers.
sents.zh: 对此问题回答 [No] 或 [N/A] 将不会给审稿人留下好的印象。

paragraphs.en: The claims made should match theoretical and experimental results, and reflect how much the results can be expected to generalize to other settings.
paragraphs.zh: 所提出的声明应与理论和实验结果相符，并反映结果在多大程度上可以预期推广到其他设置。

paragraphs.en: It is fine to include aspirational goals as motivation as long as it is clear that these goals are not attained by the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 只要明确这些目标并非论文所实现的，将愿景目标作为动机纳入是完全可以的。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper discuss the limitations of the work performed by the authors?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否讨论了作者所做工作的局限性？

paragraphs.en: Justification: We discuss limitations in Section 7 .
paragraphs.zh: 论证：我们在第 7 节中讨论局限性。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper has no limitation while the answer [No] means that the paper has limitations, but those are not discussed in the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文没有局限性，而答案 [No] 表示该论文存在局限性，但论文中未对这些局限性进行讨论。

paragraphs.en: The authors are encouraged to create a separate “Limitations” section in their paper.
paragraphs.zh: 鼓励作者在论文中单独创建一个“局限性”部分。

paragraphs.en: The paper should point out any strong assumptions and how robust the results are to violations of these assumptions (e.g., independence assumptions, noiseless settings, model well-specification, asymptotic approximations only holding locally). The authors should reflect on how these assumptions might be violated in practice and what the implications would be.
paragraphs.zh: 论文应指出任何较强的假设，并说明当这些假设被违反时结果的稳健性如何（例如，独立性假设、无噪声环境、模型设定良好、渐近近似仅在局部成立等）。 作者应反思这些假设在实践中可能如何被违反，以及由此带来的影响。

sents.en: The paper should point out any strong assumptions and how robust the results are to violations of these assumptions (e.g., independence assumptions, noiseless settings, model well-specification, asymptotic approximations only holding locally).
sents.zh: 论文应指出任何较强的假设，并说明当这些假设被违反时结果的稳健性如何（例如，独立性假设、无噪声环境、模型设定良好、渐近近似仅在局部成立等）。

sents.en: The authors should reflect on how these assumptions might be violated in practice and what the implications would be.
sents.zh: 作者应反思这些假设在实践中可能如何被违反，以及由此带来的影响。

paragraphs.en: The authors should reflect on the scope of the claims made, e.g., if the approach was only tested on a few datasets or with a few runs. In general, empirical results often depend on implicit assumptions, which should be articulated.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应当反思所提主张的适用范围，例如，如果该方法仅在少数数据集上或仅用少数几次运行进行了测试。 总体而言，实证结果往往依赖于一些隐含的假设，这些假设应当被明确阐述。

sents.en: The authors should reflect on the scope of the claims made, e.g., if the approach was only tested on a few datasets or with a few runs.
sents.zh: 作者应当反思所提主张的适用范围，例如，如果该方法仅在少数数据集上或仅用少数几次运行进行了测试。

sents.en: In general, empirical results often depend on implicit assumptions, which should be articulated.
sents.zh: 总体而言，实证结果往往依赖于一些隐含的假设，这些假设应当被明确阐述。

paragraphs.en: The authors should reflect on the factors that influence the performance of the approach. For example, a facial recognition algorithm may perform poorly when image resolution is low or images are taken in low lighting. Or a speech-to-text system might not be used reliably to provide closed captions for online lectures because it fails to handle technical jargon.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应当反思影响该方法性能的各种因素。 例如，当图像分辨率较低或在弱光环境下拍摄的图像时，人脸识别算法可能表现不佳。 或者，语音转文字系统可能无法可靠地用于为在线讲座提供隐藏式字幕，因为它无法处理技术术语。

sents.en: The authors should reflect on the factors that influence the performance of the approach.
sents.zh: 作者应当反思影响该方法性能的各种因素。

sents.en: For example, a facial recognition algorithm may perform poorly when image resolution is low or images are taken in low lighting.
sents.zh: 例如，当图像分辨率较低或在弱光环境下拍摄的图像时，人脸识别算法可能表现不佳。

sents.en: Or a speech-to-text system might not be used reliably to provide closed captions for online lectures because it fails to handle technical jargon.
sents.zh: 或者，语音转文字系统可能无法可靠地用于为在线讲座提供隐藏式字幕，因为它无法处理技术术语。

paragraphs.en: The authors should discuss the computational efficiency of the proposed algorithms and how they scale with dataset size.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应讨论所提出算法的计算效率，以及它们如何随数据集规模进行扩展。

paragraphs.en: If applicable, the authors should discuss possible limitations of their approach to address problems of privacy and fairness.
paragraphs.zh: 如果适用，作者应讨论其方法在解决隐私和公平性问题方面可能存在的局限性。

paragraphs.en: While the authors might fear that complete honesty about limitations might be used by reviewers as grounds for rejection, a worse outcome might be that reviewers discover limitations that aren’t acknowledged in the paper. The authors should use their best judgment and recognize that individual actions in favor of transparency play an important role in developing norms that preserve the integrity of the community. Reviewers will be specifically instructed to not penalize honesty concerning limitations.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然作者可能担心对局限性的完全坦诚会被审稿人用作拒稿的理由，但更糟糕的结果可能是审稿人发现了论文中未提及的局限性。 作者应尽其最佳判断，并认识到支持透明度的个人行为在发展维护学术界诚信的规范方面发挥着重要作用。 审稿人将被明确指示，不得因对局限性的坦诚而扣分。

sents.en: While the authors might fear that complete honesty about limitations might be used by reviewers as grounds for rejection, a worse outcome might be that reviewers discover limitations that aren’t acknowledged in the paper.
sents.zh: 虽然作者可能担心对局限性的完全坦诚会被审稿人用作拒稿的理由，但更糟糕的结果可能是审稿人发现了论文中未提及的局限性。

sents.en: The authors should use their best judgment and recognize that individual actions in favor of transparency play an important role in developing norms that preserve the integrity of the community.

sents.en: Reviewers will be specifically instructed to not penalize honesty concerning limitations.
sents.zh: 审稿人将被明确指示，不得因对局限性的坦诚而扣分。

paragraphs.en: Question: For each theoretical result, does the paper provide the full set of assumptions and a complete (and correct) proof?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：对于每一条理论结果，论文是否提供了完整的假设集合以及完整（且正确）的证明？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The paper does not contain any theoretical results.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：该论文不包含任何理论结果。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not include theoretical results.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文不包含理论结果。

paragraphs.en: All the theorems, formulas, and proofs in the paper should be numbered and cross-referenced.
paragraphs.zh: 论文中所有的定理、公式和证明都应编号并交叉引用。

paragraphs.en: All assumptions should be clearly stated or referenced in the statement of any theorems.
paragraphs.zh: 任何定理的陈述中都应清楚说明或引用所有假设。

paragraphs.en: The proofs can either appear in the main paper or the supplemental material, but if they appear in the supplemental material, the authors are encouraged to provide a short proof sketch to provide intuition.
paragraphs.zh: 证明可以出现在正文或补充材料中，但如果证明出现在补充材料中，鼓励作者提供一个简短的证明概要以提供直觉。

paragraphs.en: Inversely, any informal proof provided in the core of the paper should be complemented by formal proofs provided in appendix or supplemental material.
paragraphs.zh: 反过来说，论文正文中提供的任何非正式证明，都应通过附录或补充材料中提供的正式证明加以补充。

paragraphs.en: Theorems and Lemmas that the proof relies upon should be properly referenced.
paragraphs.zh: 证明所依赖的定理和引理应被正确引用。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper fully disclose all the information needed to reproduce the main experimental results of the paper to the extent that it affects the main claims and/or conclusions of the paper (regardless of whether the code and data are provided or not)?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否充分披露了复现论文主要实验结果所需的全部信息，以达到影响论文主要主张和/或结论的程度（无论是否提供了代码和数据）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: Environments are described in Appendix D , prompts are given in Appendix G.3 , and the remaining implementation details required to reproduce our results are provided in Appendix G .
paragraphs.zh: 理由：环境在附录 D 中描述，提示词在附录 G.3 中给出，复现我们结果所需的其余实现细节见附录 G。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not include experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文不包含实验。

paragraphs.en: If the paper includes experiments, a [No] answer to this question will not be perceived well by the reviewers: Making the paper reproducible is important, regardless of whether the code and data are provided or not.
paragraphs.zh: 如果论文包含实验，审稿人对该问题回答 [No] 的观感不会好：无论是否提供代码和数据，使论文具有可复现性都很重要。

paragraphs.en: If the contribution is a dataset and/or model, the authors should describe the steps taken to make their results reproducible or verifiable.
paragraphs.zh: 如果贡献是数据集和/或模型，作者应描述其为使结果可复现或可验证所采取的步骤。

paragraphs.en: Depending on the contribution, reproducibility can be accomplished in various ways. For example, if the contribution is a novel architecture, describing the architecture fully might suffice, or if the contribution is a specific model and empirical evaluation, it may be necessary to either make it possible for others to replicate the model with the same dataset, or provide access to the model. In general. releasing code and data is often one good way to accomplish this, but reproducibility can also be provided via detailed instructions for how to replicate the results, access to a hosted model (e.g., in the case of a large language model), releasing of a model checkpoint, or other means that are appropriate to the research performed.
paragraphs.zh: 根据贡献的不同，可以通过多种方式实现可复现性。 例如，如果贡献是一种新架构，那么完整地描述该架构可能就足够了；或者如果贡献是一个特定模型及其实证评估，则可能需要让他人能够使用相同的数据集复现该模型，或者提供对该模型的访问。 总的来说，发布代码和数据通常是实现这一目标的一种好方法，但可复现性也可以通过提供复现结果的详细说明、提供托管模型的访问（例如，在大语言模型的情况下）、发布模型检查点或其他适合所做研究的方式来保障。

sents.en: Depending on the contribution, reproducibility can be accomplished in various ways.
sents.zh: 根据贡献的不同，可以通过多种方式实现可复现性。

sents.en: For example, if the contribution is a novel architecture, describing the architecture fully might suffice, or if the contribution is a specific model and empirical evaluation, it may be necessary to either make it possible for others to replicate the model with the same dataset, or provide access to the model.
sents.zh: 例如，如果贡献是一种新架构，那么完整地描述该架构可能就足够了；或者如果贡献是一个特定模型及其实证评估，则可能需要让他人能够使用相同的数据集复现该模型，或者提供对该模型的访问。

sents.en: In general. releasing code and data is often one good way to accomplish this, but reproducibility can also be provided via detailed instructions for how to replicate the results, access to a hosted model (e.g., in the case of a large language model), releasing of a model checkpoint, or other means that are appropriate to the research performed.
sents.zh: 总的来说，发布代码和数据通常是实现这一目标的一种好方法，但可复现性也可以通过提供复现结果的详细说明、提供托管模型的访问（例如，在大语言模型的情况下）、发布模型检查点或其他适合所做研究的方式来保障。

paragraphs.en: While NeurIPS does not require releasing code, the conference does require all submissions to provide some reasonable avenue for reproducibility, which may depend on the nature of the contribution. For example
paragraphs.zh: 虽然 NeurIPS 不要求发布代码，但会议确实要求所有投稿提供某种合理的可复现性途径，这可能取决于贡献的性质。例如

paragraphs.en: If the contribution is primarily a new algorithm, the paper should make it clear how to reproduce that algorithm.
paragraphs.zh: 如果贡献主要是一种新算法，论文应清楚说明如何复现该算法。

paragraphs.en: If the contribution is primarily a new model architecture, the paper should describe the architecture clearly and fully.
paragraphs.zh: 如果贡献主要是一种新的模型架构，论文应清晰且完整地描述该架构。

paragraphs.en: If the contribution is a new model (e.g., a large language model), then there should either be a way to access this model for reproducing the results or a way to reproduce the model (e.g., with an open-source dataset or instructions for how to construct the dataset).
paragraphs.zh: 如果贡献是新模型（例如大型语言模型），则应当提供访问该模型以复现结果的方式，或提供复现该模型的方式（例如使用开源数据集或关于如何构建该数据集的说明）。

paragraphs.en: We recognize that reproducibility may be tricky in some cases, in which case authors are welcome to describe the particular way they provide for reproducibility. In the case of closed-source models, it may be that access to the model is limited in some way (e.g., to registered users), but it should be possible for other researchers to have some path to reproducing or verifying the results.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认识到，在某些情况下可复现性可能比较棘手，在这种情况下，欢迎作者描述他们为可复现性提供的具体方式。 对于闭源模型，对模型的访问可能在某种程度上受到限制（例如，仅限注册用户），但其他研究者应当有某种途径来复现或验证结果。

sents.en: We recognize that reproducibility may be tricky in some cases, in which case authors are welcome to describe the particular way they provide for reproducibility.
sents.zh: 我们认识到，在某些情况下可复现性可能比较棘手，在这种情况下，欢迎作者描述他们为可复现性提供的具体方式。

sents.en: In the case of closed-source models, it may be that access to the model is limited in some way (e.g., to registered users), but it should be possible for other researchers to have some path to reproducing or verifying the results.
sents.zh: 对于闭源模型，对模型的访问可能在某种程度上受到限制（例如，仅限注册用户），但其他研究者应当有某种途径来复现或验证结果。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper provide open access to the data and code, with sufficient instructions to faithfully reproduce the main experimental results, as described in supplemental material?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否按照补充材料中的描述，提供了对数据和代码的开放访问，并附有足以忠实复现主要实验结果的说明？

paragraphs.en: Justification: Anonymised code with run instructions to reproduce all experiments is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/zsc_llm-EAE1/README.md .
paragraphs.zh: 理由：包含运行说明的匿名化代码可用于复现所有实验，链接为 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/zsc_llm-EAE1/README.md 。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that paper does not include experiments requiring code.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文不包含需要代码的实验。

paragraphs.en: Please see the NeurIPS code and data submission guidelines ( https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy ) for more details.
paragraphs.zh: 请参阅 NeurIPS 代码与数据提交指南（ https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy ）了解更多详情。

paragraphs.en: While we encourage the release of code and data, we understand that this might not be possible, so [No] is an acceptable answer. Papers cannot be rejected simply for not including code, unless this is central to the contribution (e.g., for a new open-source benchmark).
paragraphs.zh: 虽然我们鼓励发布代码和数据，但我们理解这可能无法实现，因此「否」是可以接受的答案。 论文不能仅仅因为未包含代码而被拒稿，除非这是其贡献的核心部分（例如，对于一个新的开源基准）。

sents.en: While we encourage the release of code and data, we understand that this might not be possible, so [No] is an acceptable answer.
sents.zh: 虽然我们鼓励发布代码和数据，但我们理解这可能无法实现，因此「否」是可以接受的答案。

sents.en: Papers cannot be rejected simply for not including code, unless this is central to the contribution (e.g., for a new open-source benchmark).
sents.zh: 论文不能仅仅因为未包含代码而被拒稿，除非这是其贡献的核心部分（例如，对于一个新的开源基准）。

paragraphs.en: The instructions should contain the exact command and environment needed to run to reproduce the results. See the NeurIPS code and data submission guidelines ( https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy ) for more details.
paragraphs.zh: 说明中应包含运行以复现结果所需的确切命令和环境。 更多细节请参阅 NeurIPS 代码与数据提交指南（ https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy ）。

sents.en: The instructions should contain the exact command and environment needed to run to reproduce the results.
sents.zh: 说明中应包含运行以复现结果所需的确切命令和环境。

sents.en: See the NeurIPS code and data submission guidelines ( https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy ) for more details.
sents.zh: 更多细节请参阅 NeurIPS 代码与数据提交指南（ https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy ）。

paragraphs.en: The authors should provide instructions on data access and preparation, including how to access the raw data, preprocessed data, intermediate data, and generated data, etc.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应提供有关数据访问和准备的说明，包括如何访问原始数据、预处理数据、中间数据以及生成的数据等。

paragraphs.en: The authors should provide scripts to reproduce all experimental results for the new proposed method and baselines. If only a subset of experiments are reproducible, they should state which ones are omitted from the script and why.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应提供脚本，用于复现新提出方法与基线的所有实验结果。 如果只有部分实验可以复现，作者应说明哪些实验未包含在脚本中以及原因。

sents.en: The authors should provide scripts to reproduce all experimental results for the new proposed method and baselines.
sents.zh: 作者应提供脚本，用于复现新提出方法与基线的所有实验结果。

sents.en: If only a subset of experiments are reproducible, they should state which ones are omitted from the script and why.
sents.zh: 如果只有部分实验可以复现，作者应说明哪些实验未包含在脚本中以及原因。

paragraphs.en: At submission time, to preserve anonymity, the authors should release anonymized versions (if applicable).
paragraphs.zh: 在提交时，为保持匿名性，作者应发布匿名版本（如适用）。

paragraphs.en: Providing as much information as possible in supplemental material (appended to the paper) is recommended, but including URLs to data and code is permitted.
paragraphs.zh: 建议在补充材料（附于论文之后）中提供尽可能多的信息，但允许包含指向数据和代码的 URL。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper specify all the training and test details (e.g., data splits, hyperparameters, how they were chosen, type of optimizer) necessary to understand the results?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否指定了理解结果所需的全部训练和测试细节（例如：数据划分、超参数、它们是如何选择的、优化器的类型）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: Experimental settings and hyperparameters are described in Figure 3 , and full implementation details for the meta-learning optimisation are provided in Appendix G .
paragraphs.zh: 说明：实验设置和超参数见图 3，元学习优化的完整实现细节见附录 G。

paragraphs.en: The experimental setting should be presented in the core of the paper to a level of detail that is necessary to appreciate the results and make sense of them.
paragraphs.zh: 实验设置应在论文的核心部分进行介绍，详细程度应以理解实验结果并使其有意义为准。

paragraphs.en: The full details can be provided either with the code, in appendix, or as supplemental material.
paragraphs.zh: 完整的详细信息可以通过随代码提供、放在附录中，或作为补充材料的方式给出。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper report error bars suitably and correctly defined or other appropriate information about the statistical significance of the experiments?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否恰当地报告了误差棒及其正确定义，或其他关于实验统计显著性的适当信息？

paragraphs.en: Justification: We report the mean and standard error over multiple random seeds for all results; the protocol used to compute these statistics is detailed in Appendix F.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 依据：我们对所有结果报告了多个随机种子上的均值和标准误差；用于计算这些统计数据的协议详见附录 F.3。

paragraphs.en: The authors should answer [Yes] if the results are accompanied by error bars, confidence intervals, or statistical significance tests, at least for the experiments that support the main claims of the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 如果结果附有误差条、置信区间或统计显著性检验，作者应回答 [Yes]，至少在支持论文主要论点的实验中应如此。

paragraphs.en: The factors of variability that the error bars are capturing should be clearly stated (for example, train/test split, initialization, random drawing of some parameter, or overall run with given experimental conditions).
paragraphs.zh: 误差条所捕捉到的变化因素应当被清楚地说明（例如，训练/测试集划分、初始化、某个参数的随机抽取，或在给定实验条件下的整体运行）。

paragraphs.en: The method for calculating the error bars should be explained (closed form formula, call to a library function, bootstrap, etc.)
paragraphs.zh: 误差条（error bars）的计算方法应当加以说明（解析公式、调用库函数、自助法（bootstrap）等）。

paragraphs.en: The assumptions made should be given (e.g., Normally distributed errors).
paragraphs.zh: 应给出所作的假设（例如，误差服从正态分布）。

paragraphs.en: It should be clear whether the error bar is the standard deviation or the standard error of the mean.
paragraphs.zh: 应明确误差棒是标准差还是平均值的标准误。

paragraphs.en: It is OK to report 1-sigma error bars, but one should state it. The authors should preferably report a 2-sigma error bar than state that they have a 96% CI, if the hypothesis of Normality of errors is not verified.
paragraphs.zh: 报告 1-sigma 误差范围是可以的，但应当予以说明。 如果误差服从正态分布的假设未被验证，作者最好报告 2-sigma 误差范围，而不是声称他们拥有 96% 的置信区间。

sents.en: It is OK to report 1-sigma error bars, but one should state it.
sents.zh: 报告 1-sigma 误差范围是可以的，但应当予以说明。

sents.en: The authors should preferably report a 2-sigma error bar than state that they have a 96% CI, if the hypothesis of Normality of errors is not verified.
sents.zh: 如果误差服从正态分布的假设未被验证，作者最好报告 2-sigma 误差范围，而不是声称他们拥有 96% 的置信区间。

paragraphs.en: For asymmetric distributions, the authors should be careful not to show in tables or figures symmetric error bars that would yield results that are out of range (e.g., negative error rates).
paragraphs.zh: 对于不对称的分布，作者应当注意不要在表格或图表中展示会得出超出范围结果（例如负的误差率）的对称误差条。

paragraphs.en: If error bars are reported in tables or plots, the authors should explain in the text how they were calculated and reference the corresponding figures or tables in the text.
paragraphs.zh: 如果误差棒在表格或图中有所报告，作者应在文中说明其计算方法，并在正文中引用相应的图或表。

paragraphs.en: Question: For each experiment, does the paper provide sufficient information on the computer resources (type of compute workers, memory, time of execution) needed to reproduce the experiments?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：对于每个实验，论文是否提供了足够的信息说明重现实验所需的计算机资源（计算工作节点的类型、内存、执行时间）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: API costs and the GPU used for the token-level probability experiments are reported in Appendix G.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 依据：API 成本以及用于词元级概率实验的 GPU 已在附录 G.4 中报告。

paragraphs.en: The paper should indicate the type of compute workers CPU or GPU, internal cluster, or cloud provider, including relevant memory and storage.
paragraphs.zh: 论文应说明所使用的计算工作节点类型（CPU 还是 GPU）、内部集群或云服务提供商，并包括相关的内存和存储信息。

paragraphs.en: The paper should provide the amount of compute required for each of the individual experimental runs as well as estimate the total compute.
paragraphs.zh: 论文应提供每次单独实验运行所需的计算量，并估算总计算量。

paragraphs.en: The paper should disclose whether the full research project required more compute than the experiments reported in the paper (e.g., preliminary or failed experiments that didn’t make it into the paper).
paragraphs.zh: 论文应披露完整研究项目是否需要比论文中所报告实验更多的计算资源（例如，未能写入论文的初步实验或失败实验）。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the research conducted in the paper conform, in every respect, with the NeurIPS Code of Ethics https://neurips.cc/public/EthicsGuidelines ?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文中进行的研究是否在各方面都符合 NeurIPS 伦理准则 https://neurips.cc/public/EthicsGuidelines ？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The research conforms to the NeurIPS Code of Ethics.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：该研究符合 NeurIPS 伦理准则（Code of Ethics）。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the authors have not reviewed the NeurIPS Code of Ethics.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示作者尚未审阅 NeurIPS 伦理准则。

paragraphs.en: If the authors answer [No] , they should explain the special circumstances that require a deviation from the Code of Ethics.
paragraphs.zh: 如果作者回答 [No]，则应说明需要偏离伦理准则的特殊情况。

paragraphs.en: The authors should make sure to preserve anonymity (e.g., if there is a special consideration due to laws or regulations in their jurisdiction).
paragraphs.zh: 作者应确保保持匿名性（例如，如果其所在司法管辖区的法律或法规有特殊考虑）。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper discuss both potential positive societal impacts and negative societal impacts of the work performed?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否既讨论了所做工作可能带来的积极社会影响，也讨论了可能的消极社会影响？

paragraphs.en: Justification: Broader impacts are discussed in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 合理性说明：更广泛的影响将在附录 B 中讨论。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that there is no societal impact of the work performed.
paragraphs.zh: 回答 [N/A] 表示所开展的工作没有社会影响。

paragraphs.en: If the authors answer [N/A] or [No] , they should explain why their work has no societal impact or why the paper does not address societal impact.
paragraphs.zh: 如果作者回答 [N/A] 或 [No]，他们应当解释为什么其工作没有社会影响，或为什么论文未涉及社会影响。

paragraphs.en: Examples of negative societal impacts include potential malicious or unintended uses (e.g., disinformation, generating fake profiles, surveillance), fairness considerations (e.g., deployment of technologies that could make decisions that unfairly impact specific groups), privacy considerations, and security considerations.
paragraphs.zh: 负面社会影响的例子包括潜在的恶意或非预期用途（例如，虚假信息、生成虚假档案、监控）、公平性考量（例如，部署可能做出对特定群体产生不公平影响决策的技术）、隐私考量以及安全性考量。

paragraphs.en: The conference expects that many papers will be foundational research and not tied to particular applications, let alone deployments. However, if there is a direct path to any negative applications, the authors should point it out. For example, it is legitimate to point out that an improvement in the quality of generative models could be used to generate Deepfakes for disinformation. On the other hand, it is not needed to point out that a generic algorithm for optimizing neural networks could enable people to train models that generate Deepfakes faster.
paragraphs.zh: 会议预期许多论文将是基础性研究，并不与特定应用挂钩，更不用说实际部署了。 然而，如果存在通往任何负面应用的直接路径，作者应当指出这一点。 例如，指出生成式模型质量的提升可能被用于生成传播虚假信息的深度伪造（Deepfakes），是合理的。 另一方面，不需要指出一个用于优化神经网络的通用算法可能使人们能够更快地训练生成深度伪造的模型。

sents.en: The conference expects that many papers will be foundational research and not tied to particular applications, let alone deployments.
sents.zh: 会议预期许多论文将是基础性研究，并不与特定应用挂钩，更不用说实际部署了。

sents.en: However, if there is a direct path to any negative applications, the authors should point it out.
sents.zh: 然而，如果存在通往任何负面应用的直接路径，作者应当指出这一点。

sents.en: For example, it is legitimate to point out that an improvement in the quality of generative models could be used to generate Deepfakes for disinformation.
sents.zh: 例如，指出生成式模型质量的提升可能被用于生成传播虚假信息的深度伪造（Deepfakes），是合理的。

sents.en: On the other hand, it is not needed to point out that a generic algorithm for optimizing neural networks could enable people to train models that generate Deepfakes faster.
sents.zh: 另一方面，不需要指出一个用于优化神经网络的通用算法可能使人们能够更快地训练生成深度伪造的模型。

paragraphs.en: The authors should consider possible harms that could arise when the technology is being used as intended and functioning correctly, harms that could arise when the technology is being used as intended but gives incorrect results, and harms following from (intentional or unintentional) misuse of the technology.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应当考虑以下几类可能的危害：技术在被按预期使用且正常运行时可能产生的危害；技术在被按预期使用但给出错误结果时可能产生的危害；以及由对技术的（有意或无意的）滥用所导致的危害。

paragraphs.en: If there are negative societal impacts, the authors could also discuss possible mitigation strategies (e.g., gated release of models, providing defenses in addition to attacks, mechanisms for monitoring misuse, mechanisms to monitor how a system learns from feedback over time, improving the efficiency and accessibility of ML).
paragraphs.zh: 如果存在负面的社会影响，作者还可以讨论可能的缓解策略（例如，模型的受控发布、在提供攻击的同时提供防御、监控滥用的机制、监控系统如何随时间从反馈中学习的机制、提高机器学习的效率和可及性）。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper describe safeguards that have been put in place for responsible release of data or models that have a high risk for misuse (e.g., pre-trained language models, image generators, or scraped datasets)?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否描述了为负责任地发布具有较高滥用风险的数据或模型（例如预训练语言模型、图像生成器或抓取的数据集）而采取的保障措施？

paragraphs.en: Justification: This paper poses no such risks.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：本文不存在此类风险。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper poses no such risks.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文不存在此类风险。

paragraphs.en: Released models that have a high risk for misuse or dual-use should be released with necessary safeguards to allow for controlled use of the model, for example by requiring that users adhere to usage guidelines or restrictions to access the model or implementing safety filters.
paragraphs.zh: 具有较高误用或双重用途风险的已发布模型，应当附带必要的安全保障措施以实现对模型的受控使用，例如要求用户遵守使用指南或限制才能访问模型，或实施安全过滤器。

paragraphs.en: Datasets that have been scraped from the Internet could pose safety risks. The authors should describe how they avoided releasing unsafe images.
paragraphs.zh: 从互联网上抓取的数据集可能带来安全风险。 作者应描述他们如何避免发布不安全的图像。

sents.en: Datasets that have been scraped from the Internet could pose safety risks.
sents.zh: 从互联网上抓取的数据集可能带来安全风险。

sents.en: The authors should describe how they avoided releasing unsafe images.
sents.zh: 作者应描述他们如何避免发布不安全的图像。

paragraphs.en: We recognize that providing effective safeguards is challenging, and many papers do not require this, but we encourage authors to take this into account and make a best faith effort.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认识到，提供有效的保障措施具有挑战性，而且许多论文并不要求这样做，但我们鼓励作者将这一点考虑在内，并尽最大努力去做到。

paragraphs.en: Question: Are the creators or original owners of assets (e.g., code, data, models), used in the paper, properly credited and are the license and terms of use explicitly mentioned and properly respected?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文中使用的资产（如代码、数据、模型）的创作者或原所有者是否得到了恰当的署名，且许可证和使用条款是否被明确提及并得到恰当遵守？

paragraphs.en: Justification: Licenses for the figures and environments reused from prior work are listed in Appendix C .
paragraphs.zh: 理由：从先前工作复用的图表和环境所使用的许可证在附录 C 中列出。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not use existing assets.
paragraphs.zh: 回答 [N/A] 表示该论文未使用现有资产。

paragraphs.en: The authors should cite the original paper that produced the code package or dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应引用产生该代码包或数据集的原始论文。

paragraphs.en: The authors should state which version of the asset is used and, if possible, include a URL.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应说明所使用的是该资产的哪个版本，并尽可能提供 URL。

paragraphs.en: The name of the license (e.g., CC-BY 4.0) should be included for each asset.
paragraphs.zh: 每个资产都应包含许可证名称（例如 CC-BY 4.0）。

paragraphs.en: For scraped data from a particular source (e.g., website), the copyright and terms of service of that source should be provided.
paragraphs.zh: 对于从特定来源（例如网站）抓取的数据，应提供该来源的版权和服务条款。

paragraphs.en: If assets are released, the license, copyright information, and terms of use in the package should be provided. For popular datasets, paperswithcode.com/datasets has curated licenses for some datasets. Their licensing guide can help determine the license of a dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 如果发布资产，应提供软件包中的许可证、版权信息和使用条款。 对于热门数据集，paperswithcode.com/datasets 已为部分数据集整理了许可证信息。 其许可指南可以帮助确定数据集的许可证。

sents.en: If assets are released, the license, copyright information, and terms of use in the package should be provided.
sents.zh: 如果发布资产，应提供软件包中的许可证、版权信息和使用条款。

sents.en: For popular datasets, paperswithcode.com/datasets has curated licenses for some datasets.
sents.zh: 对于热门数据集，paperswithcode.com/datasets 已为部分数据集整理了许可证信息。

sents.en: Their licensing guide can help determine the license of a dataset.
sents.zh: 其许可指南可以帮助确定数据集的许可证。

paragraphs.en: For existing datasets that are re-packaged, both the original license and the license of the derived asset (if it has changed) should be provided.
paragraphs.zh: 对于重新打包的现有数据集，应同时提供原始许可证以及衍生资产的许可证（如果其发生了变化）。

paragraphs.en: If this information is not available online, the authors are encouraged to reach out to the asset’s creators.
paragraphs.zh: 如果这些信息无法在网上获取，建议作者联系该资产的创建者。

paragraphs.en: Question: Are new assets introduced in the paper well documented and is the documentation provided alongside the assets?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文中引入的新资产是否有完善的文档记录，且文档是否随资产一并提供？

paragraphs.en: Justification: We introduce seven new coordination environments (Narrow Tunnel, Brittle Bridge, Ad-Hoc Conventions, Ad-Hoc Conventions with Permuted Signals, Permuted Levers, Semantic Selection Game, and Semantic Convention Game), all provided with documentation in the anonymised code repository ( https://anonymous.4open.science/r/zsc_llm-EAE1/README.md ). The same repository also includes our re-implementations of the reused environments (Cat & Dog, Tiny Hanabi, Hanabi 3 × \times 3, Matrix Game, Hint–Guess, and Trampoline–Tiger), each augmented with natural-language descriptions for interaction with LLM agents.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：我们引入了七个新的协调环境（窄隧道、脆桥、临时约定、带置换信号的临时约定、置换拉杆、语义选择博弈和语义约定博弈），全部在匿名代码仓库（ https://anonymous.4open.science/r/zsc_llm-EAE1/README.md ）中提供了文档说明。 同一仓库还包含我们对复用环境（猫与狗、小五子棋、五子棋 3 × \times 3、矩阵博弈、提示–猜测和跳板–老虎）的重新实现，每个环境都增加了用于与 LLM 智能体交互的自然语言描述。

sents.en: Justification: We introduce seven new coordination environments (Narrow Tunnel, Brittle Bridge, Ad-Hoc Conventions, Ad-Hoc Conventions with Permuted Signals, Permuted Levers, Semantic Selection Game, and Semantic Convention Game), all provided with documentation in the anonymised code repository ( https://anonymous.4open.science/r/zsc_llm-EAE1/README.md ).
sents.zh: 理由：我们引入了七个新的协调环境（窄隧道、脆桥、临时约定、带置换信号的临时约定、置换拉杆、语义选择博弈和语义约定博弈），全部在匿名代码仓库（ https://anonymous.4open.science/r/zsc_llm-EAE1/README.md ）中提供了文档说明。

sents.en: The same repository also includes our re-implementations of the reused environments (Cat & Dog, Tiny Hanabi, Hanabi 3 × \times 3, Matrix Game, Hint–Guess, and Trampoline–Tiger), each augmented with natural-language descriptions for interaction with LLM agents.
sents.zh: 同一仓库还包含我们对复用环境（猫与狗、小五子棋、五子棋 3 × \times 3、矩阵博弈、提示–猜测和跳板–老虎）的重新实现，每个环境都增加了用于与 LLM 智能体交互的自然语言描述。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not release new assets.
paragraphs.zh: 回答 [N/A] 表示该论文没有发布新资产。

paragraphs.en: Researchers should communicate the details of the dataset/code/model as part of their submissions via structured templates. This includes details about training, license, limitations, etc.
paragraphs.zh: 研究人员应在提交时通过结构化模板传达数据集/代码/模型的详细信息。 这包括关于训练、许可证、局限性等的细节。

sents.en: Researchers should communicate the details of the dataset/code/model as part of their submissions via structured templates.
sents.zh: 研究人员应在提交时通过结构化模板传达数据集/代码/模型的详细信息。

sents.en: This includes details about training, license, limitations, etc.
sents.zh: 这包括关于训练、许可证、局限性等的细节。

paragraphs.en: The paper should discuss whether and how consent was obtained from people whose asset is used.
paragraphs.zh: 论文应讨论是否以及如何从其资产被使用的人那里获得同意。

paragraphs.en: At submission time, remember to anonymize your assets (if applicable). You can either create an anonymized URL or include an anonymized zip file.
paragraphs.zh: 在提交时，请记得对你的资源进行匿名化处理（如适用）。 你可以创建一个匿名化的 URL，或附上一个匿名化的 zip 文件。

sents.en: At submission time, remember to anonymize your assets (if applicable).
sents.zh: 在提交时，请记得对你的资源进行匿名化处理（如适用）。

sents.en: You can either create an anonymized URL or include an anonymized zip file.
sents.zh: 你可以创建一个匿名化的 URL，或附上一个匿名化的 zip 文件。

paragraphs.en: Crowdsourcing and research with human subjects
paragraphs.zh: 众包与人类受试者研究

paragraphs.en: Question: For crowdsourcing experiments and research with human subjects, does the paper include the full text of instructions given to participants and screenshots, if applicable, as well as details about compensation (if any)?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：对于众包实验和涉及人类受试者的研究，论文是否包含给参与者的完整指示文本以及截图（如适用），以及报酬详情（如有）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The paper does not involve crowdsourcing or human subjects.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：本文不涉及众包或人类受试者。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not involve crowdsourcing nor research with human subjects.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文不涉及众包，也不涉及以人类为对象的研究。

paragraphs.en: Including this information in the supplemental material is fine, but if the main contribution of the paper involves human subjects, then as much detail as possible should be included in the main paper.
paragraphs.zh: 将这些信息包含在补充材料中是可以的，但如果论文的主要贡献涉及人类受试者，那么应尽可能多地在正文中包含相关细节。

paragraphs.en: According to the NeurIPS Code of Ethics, workers involved in data collection, curation, or other labor should be paid at least the minimum wage in the country of the data collector.
paragraphs.zh: 根据 NeurIPS 伦理准则，参与数据收集、整理或其他劳动的工作人员，其报酬应不低于数据收集者所在国家的最低工资标准。

paragraphs.en: Institutional review board (IRB) approvals or equivalent for research with human subjects
paragraphs.zh: 涉及人类受试者研究的机构审查委员会（IRB）批准或同等许可

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper describe potential risks incurred by study participants, whether such risks were disclosed to the subjects, and whether Institutional Review Board (IRB) approvals (or an equivalent approval/review based on the requirements of your country or institution) were obtained?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否描述了研究参与者可能面临的风险、此类风险是否已向受试者披露，以及是否获得了机构审查委员会（IRB）的批准（或基于您所在国家或机构要求的同等批准/审查）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The paper does not involve human subjects.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：本文不涉及人类受试者。

paragraphs.en: Depending on the country in which research is conducted, IRB approval (or equivalent) may be required for any human subjects research. If you obtained IRB approval, you should clearly state this in the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 根据研究开展所在的国家不同，任何涉及人类受试者的研究都可能需要获得伦理审查委员会（IRB）的批准（或同等审批）。 如果您获得了伦理审查委员会（IRB）的批准，应在论文中明确说明。

sents.en: Depending on the country in which research is conducted, IRB approval (or equivalent) may be required for any human subjects research.
sents.zh: 根据研究开展所在的国家不同，任何涉及人类受试者的研究都可能需要获得伦理审查委员会（IRB）的批准（或同等审批）。

sents.en: If you obtained IRB approval, you should clearly state this in the paper.
sents.zh: 如果您获得了伦理审查委员会（IRB）的批准，应在论文中明确说明。

paragraphs.en: We recognize that the procedures for this may vary significantly between institutions and locations, and we expect authors to adhere to the NeurIPS Code of Ethics and the guidelines for their institution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认识到，相关程序可能因机构和地点的不同而有显著差异，我们期望作者遵守 NeurIPS 伦理准则及其所在机构的指导方针。

paragraphs.en: For initial submissions, do not include any information that would break anonymity (if applicable), such as the institution conducting the review.
paragraphs.zh: 对于初稿提交，请勿包含任何可能破坏匿名性（如适用）的信息，例如进行评审的机构。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper describe the usage of LLMs if it is an important, original, or non-standard component of the core methods in this research? Note that if the LLM is used only for writing, editing, or formatting purposes and does not impact the core methodology, scientific rigor, or originality of the research, declaration is not required.
paragraphs.zh: 问题：如果大语言模型是本研究核心方法中重要、原创或非标准的组成部分，论文是否描述了智能体的使用情况？ 请注意，如果大语言模型仅用于写作、编辑或排版目的，且不影响核心方法、科学严谨性或研究的原创性，则无需声明。

sents.en: Question: Does the paper describe the usage of LLMs if it is an important, original, or non-standard component of the core methods in this research?
sents.zh: 问题：如果大语言模型是本研究核心方法中重要、原创或非标准的组成部分，论文是否描述了智能体的使用情况？

sents.en: Note that if the LLM is used only for writing, editing, or formatting purposes and does not impact the core methodology, scientific rigor, or originality of the research, declaration is not required.
sents.zh: 请注意，如果大语言模型仅用于写作、编辑或排版目的，且不影响核心方法、科学严谨性或研究的原创性，则无需声明。

paragraphs.en: Justification: LLMs are central to this work in two ways: (i) they are the subject of study, evaluated in the sections ZSC performance of LLM agents , Semantics and Coordination , and Coordination Friendly Definitions ; and (ii) an LLM (GPT-5.4) serves as the meta-optimisation agent in the GEPA-based loop that discovers CFDs ( Coordination Friendly Definitions , with implementation details in Appendix G ). The full list of LLMs accessed in this work and their licenses is provided in Appendix C .
paragraphs.zh: 理由：大语言模型（LLM）在本工作中以两种方式处于核心地位：（i）它们是研究的对象，在「LLM 智能体的零样本（ZSC）性能」、「语义与协调」以及「协调友好定义」各节中进行评估；（ii）一个 LLM（GPT-5.4）在基于 GEPA 的循环中充当元优化智能体，用于发现协调友好定义（CFD）（见「协调友好定义」一节，实现细节见附录 G）。 本工作中使用的所有 LLM 及其许可证的完整列表见附录 C。

sents.en: Justification: LLMs are central to this work in two ways: (i) they are the subject of study, evaluated in the sections ZSC performance of LLM agents , Semantics and Coordination , and Coordination Friendly Definitions ; and (ii) an LLM (GPT-5.4) serves as the meta-optimisation agent in the GEPA-based loop that discovers CFDs ( Coordination Friendly Definitions , with implementation details in Appendix G ).
sents.zh: 理由：大语言模型（LLM）在本工作中以两种方式处于核心地位：（i）它们是研究的对象，在「LLM 智能体的零样本（ZSC）性能」、「语义与协调」以及「协调友好定义」各节中进行评估；（ii）一个 LLM（GPT-5.4）在基于 GEPA 的循环中充当元优化智能体，用于发现协调友好定义（CFD）（见「协调友好定义」一节，实现细节见附录 G）。

sents.en: The full list of LLMs accessed in this work and their licenses is provided in Appendix C .
sents.zh: 本工作中使用的所有 LLM 及其许可证的完整列表见附录 C。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the core method development in this research does not involve LLMs as any important, original, or non-standard components.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示本研究的核心方法开发不涉及将大语言模型（LLMs）作为任何重要的、原创的或非标准的组成部分。

paragraphs.en: Please refer to our LLM policy in the NeurIPS handbook for what should or should not be described.
paragraphs.zh: 请参阅 NeurIPS 手册中的我们的 LLM 政策，了解哪些内容应当描述、哪些内容不应描述。
